t: 取消， 撤销， 删去 (vt.)
words.s: I had to cancel that order because we didn't have enough money to pay for it.
words.sz: 我们的钱不够，所以我只好把订单取消了。
words.d: To cancel means to decide that an event or a request will not happen.

t: 众多的 (adj.)
words.s: I have numerous books on my bookshelf.
words.sz: 我有大量的书在我的书架上。
words.d: If something is numerous, there are many of those things.

t: 外科医生 (n.)
words.s: He's an excellent brain surgeon.
words.sz: 他是一個優秀的腦外科醫生。
words.d: A surgeon is a doctor who is trained to do surgery.

t: 分析； 分解， 解析 (vt.)
突然的， 意外的； 唐突的， 鲁莽的 (adj.)
words.s: When the dancer fell down on her back, the ballet came to an abrupt stop.
words.d: If something is abrupt, it is sudden or unexpected.

t: 宽广的， 宽敞的 (adj.)
不赞成 (n.)
自发的， 无意识的； 自然的， 天真率直的 (adj.)
words.s: My wife made a spontaneous decision to buy a new sofa while I was at work.
words.d: When an act is spontaneous, it is not planned. It happens suddenly.

t: 遥远的， 偏僻的； 关系疏远的； 脱离的； 绝少的； 微乎其微的； 孤高的， 冷淡的 (adj.)
words.s: The TV remote control is under the couch.
words.sz: 电视遥控器在沙发下面。
words.d: A remote place is distant or far away.

t: 自助餐馆， 自助食堂 (n.)
words.s: The food in the cafeteria is cheap, and it's delicious.
words.sz: 餐廳的飯很便宜，而且很好吃。

t: 破裂 (v.)
破裂，裂开；决裂，断绝 (n.)
words.s: Sarah put too much water into the balloon, and it ruptured.
words.d: To rupture means to tear or burst open.

t: 失事，残骸；精神或身体已垮的人 (n.)
破坏 (vt.)
words.s: You're going to wreck your eyesight if you play games all the time.
words.sz: 要是你老打游戏的话，你的视力会下降的。
words.d: To wreck something means to destroy or ruin it.

t: 未经开发的， 未经使用的， 未经触动的； 处女的 (adj.)
处女，未婚女子 (n.)
words.s: The virgin goddess of the moon was known as Diana.
words.d: A virgin is someone who has never had sex.

t: 使苦恼， 折磨 (vt.)
责备， 批评 (n&vt.)
波动， 涨落， 起伏 (vi.)
卧车包房， 隔间； 分隔的空间 (n.)
words.s: I found the secret compartment quite by accident.
words.sz: 我完全是在偶然的情况下发现了密室。

t: 忧郁的， 沮丧的； 令人沮丧的； 昏暗的， 阴沉的 (adj.)
words.s: The future looked very gloomy.
words.sz: 前途一片阴暗。

t: 绑架， 诱拐 (n.)
words.s: She was terrified to find out her son had been kidnapped.
words.d: To kidnap someone is to take that person illegally.

t: 授权令；理由，根据 (n.)
证明…是正当的 (vt.)
words.s: We have a warrant to search your apartment.
words.sz: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。

t: 计算， 推算； 计划， 打算 (v.)
words.s: I calculated how much money I would need to buy the car.
words.d: To calculate is to find an answer using math.

t: 坚持不懈的， 执意的； 持续的 (adj.)
words.s: They made persistent attempts to get him to eat.
words.d: A persistent person does not give up and keeps on working.

t: 授权， 批准 (vt.)
words.s: The mayor authorized the construction of a new statue in the park.
words.d: To authorize something means to give permission for it.

t: 缘故， 理由 (n.)
words.s: I stopped smoking for the sake of my health.
words.sz: 為了健康，我不再抽菸。
words.d: The sake of something is the reason for doing it.

t: 听众， 观众； 读者 (n.)
words.s: The audience was largely made up of very young children.
words.sz: 大部分观众是年幼的儿童。
words.d: An audience is a group of people who gather to watch someone do something.

t: 排练， 排演 (n.)
以鼻吸气，用力吸入；嗅，闻 (v.)
吸气； 嗅， 闻 (n.)
叙述文， 故事； 叙述， 讲述 (n.)
占用， 拥有 (vt.)
words.s: It is the things that we do not possess which seem to us most desirable.
words.sz: 得不到的东西就最想得到。
words.d: To possess something is to have it or own it.

t: 同时发生； 相符， 相一致； 位置重合， 重叠 (vi.)
words.s: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
words.sz: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。
words.d: To coincide means to happen at the same time.

t: 中立的， 中性的 (adj.)
words.s: Switzerland is a neutral country.
words.sz: 瑞士是一个中立的国家。
words.d: If someone is neutral, then they do not help either of the two fighting sides.

t: 抓，搔，扒；刮擦，刻划 (v.)
抓痕， 划痕； 抓， 搔， 刮 (n.)
分析， 分析报告； 分解， 解析 (n.)
设计， 发明 (vt.)
words.s: The thieves devised a plan to steal the diamonds.
words.d: To devise something means to come up with an idea or plan about it.

t: 有合作意向的，乐意合作的；合作的，协作的 (adj.)
合作社， 合作商店 (n.)
words.s: Tom has been quite cooperative.
words.sz: 汤姆很合作。

t: 三部分的，三方的；三倍的，三重的 (adj.)
增至三倍 (v.)
words.s: Tom hit a triple.
words.sz: 湯姆擊出三壘安打。

t: 企图抓住 (vi.)
抓紧，紧握 (vt.)
离合器； 掌握， 控制； 把握， 抓紧 (n.)
韧度；心情，情绪 (n.)
调和， 使缓和； 回火 (vt.)
words.s: His quick temper will get him in trouble one day.
words.sz: 他的急脾气迟早会惹祸上身。
words.d: A temper is someone’s mood or a chance that they might get angry.

t: 暗中摸索，搜索；探索，搜寻 (vi.)
摸索 (vt.)
感到高兴， 充满喜悦 (vi.)
慌乱不安的； 发疯似的， 发狂的 (adj.)
words.s: The cat became frantic when I tried to give it a bath.
words.d: If people or things are frantic, they behave in a wild way because they are frightened.

t: 发痒 (vi.)
使发痒；使高兴，逗乐 (vt.)
痒 (n.)
反对， 不赞成 (vi.)
实物， 物体； 目的， 目标； 对象， 客体； 宾语 (n.)
words.s: Most Americans do not object to my calling them by their first names.
words.sz: 大多数美国人似乎不反对我直呼其名。
words.d: An object is a non-living thing that you can see or touch.

t: 谦逊的；地位低下的；简陋的 (adj.)
使谦恭； 使卑下 (vt.)
words.s: Be it ever so humble, there's no place like home.
words.sz: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝。
words.d: People who are humble do not believe that they are better than other people.

t: 商品， 货物 (n.)
words.s: Fran’s uncle made most of his money trading commodities.
words.d: A commodity is something that can be bought or sold.

t: 悬崖， 峭壁 (n.)
words.s: They would have been killed if the car had gone over the cliff.
words.sz: 车子若是掉落悬崖他们早就没命了。
words.d: A cliff is a high and often flat wall of rock.

t: 服从的， 顺从的 (adj.)
无限的， 无数的 (adj.)
words.s: Many scientists believe that the universe is infinite.
words.d: If something is infinite, it has no limit or end.

t: 痛苦， 苦恼， 苦难； 悲惨的境遇， 贫苦 (n.)
words.s: There was a lot of misery after Sam lost his dog.
words.d: Misery is extreme suffering.

t: 变模糊 (v.)
模糊，模糊的东西 (n.)
words.s: The photographer can blur the bright lights into the background.
words.d: To blur is to make something unclear or difficult to see or remember.

t: 足够 (vi.)
让步， 认输 (vi.)
承认，承认…为真；承认失败；允许，让予 (vt.)
words.s: The student conceded that he had cheated on the test.
words.d: To concede is to admit against your wish that something is true.

t: 值得注意的，显著的；著名的 (adj.)
名人， 要人 (n.)
似有道理的， 似乎正确的， 貌似可信的 (adj.)
赤道 (n.)
words.s: I crossed the equator for the first time on my trip to Australia.
words.sz: 我去澳大利亚旅游的时候第一次穿越了赤道。
words.d: The equator is an imaginary line that splits the Earth into north and south.

t: 委任状；委员会；佣金，回扣；授权，委托 (n.)
委任， 委托 (vt.)
words.s: How much is the commission?
words.sz: 手续费是多少？
words.d: To commission someone is to pay that person to do some job.

t: 楼梯 (n.)
words.s: The staircase leads directly into the kitchen.
words.d: A staircase is a set of stairs found inside a building.

t: 〈口〉无理的， 轻率的， 轻浮的 (adj.)
快速翻动，转动 (vt.)
捻掷，轻抛；轻拍 (n.)
words.s: Unable to find a spatula, Tom used tongs to flip the pancakes.
words.sz: 湯姆找不到鍋鏟了，只好用夾子為煎餅翻面。
words.d: To flip means to press a switch quickly to turn it on or off.

t: 理性的， 理智的； 合理的 (adj.)
路障，栅栏，障碍 (n.)
设路障于， 挡住 (vt.)
重新开始， 继续， 恢复 (vt.)
摘要， 概要； 简历 (n.)
words.s: I don't worry so much about my resume.
words.sz: 我對自己的履歷不那麼在意。
words.d: To resume something means to start it again after taking a break.

t: 挑衅的， 煽动的， 刺激的； 挑逗的 (adj.)
委员会， 全体委员 (n.)
words.s: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
words.sz: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。
words.d: A committee is a group of people who meet together to make decisions.

t: 摆出姿势， 装模作样 (vi.)
姿势，姿态；看法，态度 (n.)
words.s: Your back will feel better if you improve your posture.
words.d: A person’s posture is the manner in which they stand or sit.

t: 盘旋上升； 不断急剧地上升 (vi.)
螺旋的 (adj.)
螺旋，螺旋式的上升 (n.)
words.s: A strand of DNA looks like two interlocking spirals.
words.d: A spiral is a shape which winds round and round as if around a cylinder.

t: 微妙的， 难以捉摸的； 诡秘的， 狡诈的； 隐约的 (adj.)
words.s: There are subtle differences between the two pictures.
words.sz: 这两张图片之间有细致的差异。
words.d: When something is subtle, it is not easy to see or notice.

t: 组成的， 构成的 (adj.)
组成部分，部件，组件 (n.)
words.s: Computers have many different components, so they are complicated to build.
words.d: A component is a part of a larger machine.

t: 使受不了， 使不知所措； 征服， 制服 (vt.)
words.s: I didn't mean to overwhelm you.
words.sz: 我沒有想要讓你不知所措。
words.d: To overwhelm is to exist in such a large amount that someone cannot deal with it.

t: 套间； 一套家具； 套， 组， 系列 (n.)
顾问； 会诊医师， 专科医生 (n.)
假扮，化装，伪装；掩盖，掩饰 (vt.)
用来伪装的东西； 伪装， 掩饰 (n.)
words.s: Everyone knew that it was Dad in the Santa disguise.
words.d: A disguise is something you wear so people cannot tell who you are.

t: 帝国的， 帝王的； 英制的 (adj.)
words.s: Meet me at the lobby of the Imperial Hotel at 6:30 p.m.
words.sz: 下午六点半到帝国酒店的大堂找我。
words.d: If something is imperial, then it is related to an empire.

t: 一个方面； 面 (n.)
心胸宽大的， 慷慨的； 自由的， 自由主义的 (adj.)
外科， 外科手术； 手术室 (n.)
words.s: Cosmetic surgery is not covered by most insurance plans.
words.sz: 大部份的保險計劃不包含整容手術。
words.d: Surgery is medical treatment involving a doctor cutting into a body.

t: 调和； 协调； 和谐 (n.)
words.s: We must learn to live in harmony with nature.
words.sz: 我们必须学会与自然和谐共处。
words.d: Harmony is a feeling that everything is peaceful, balanced, and in agreement.

t: 暴力引起的， 强暴的； 猛烈的， 剧烈的 (adj.)
words.s: The man was put into jail because he was violent.
words.d: A violent person or animal uses force to hurt others.

t: 决定；解决；分解 (v.)
决心 (n.)
words.s: She resolved the problem with her children by giving them both a toy.
words.d: To resolve something means to find a solution.

t: 舒适的； 亲切友好的 (adj.)
words.s: He lives in a cozy little house.
words.sz: 他住在一個舒適的小房子裡。
words.d: If something is cozy, then it is comfortable, warm, and relaxing.

t: 迎面遇到， 遭遇； 勇敢地面对， 正视； 使对质， 使当面对证 (vt.)
words.s: I confronted him as he left the meeting and told him I thought he was wrong.
words.d: When you confront someone, you meet them face to face to deal with a problem.

t: 在…中占首要地位； 支配， 统治； 耸立于， 俯视； 拥有优势 (v.)
words.s: The loud man dominated the conversation.
words.d: To dominate someone or something is to control them.

t: 模仿； 仿效； 仿制 (vt.)
words.s: Parrots can imitate the human voice.
words.sz: 鸚鵡會模仿人的聲音。
words.d: To imitate someone or something is to act in the exact same way.

t: 非常， 极度地 (adv.)
致死的，致命的；不共戴天的；极度的，十足的 (adj.)
words.s: The tip of the spear was dipped in a deadly poison.
words.sz: 矛尖浸在一種致命的毒藥裡。

t: 计算， 估算 (v.)
words.s: Scientists can easily compute the distance between planets.
words.sz: 科學家們可以很容易地計算出行星之間的距離。

t: 协会； 制度； 习俗 (n.)
words.s: Banks are vital institutions that businesses and people use every day.
words.d: An institution is an organization that works to help a city or group of people.

t: 聚集在一起，挤作一团；把身子蜷成一团，蜷缩 (vi.)
使聚集在一起 (vt.)
挤在一起的人； 一堆杂乱的东西 (n.)
骨骼； 框架， 骨干； 梗概， 提要 (n.)
words.s: The explorers discovered a skeleton in the cave.
words.sz: 探险家们在洞穴里发现了骸骨。
words.d: A skeleton is all the bones of a body.

t: 雄心， 抱负， 野心； 期望得到的东西 (n.)
words.s: Mary wanted to marry a man with ambition.
words.sz: 以前，玛丽想和一位有雄心壮志的男人结婚。
words.d: Ambition is the desire to succeed and to become the best at something.

t: 道路交叉口， 交点 (n.)
words.s: Turn right at the next intersection.
words.sz: 请在下一个十字路口右转。

t: 超过， 胜过， 超出 (vt.)
words.s: Don't exceed the speed limit.
words.sz: 不要超速。
words.d: To exceed is to be more than something.

t: 使生效， 履行， 实施 (vt.)
工具， 器具， 用具 (n.)
words.s: The school decided to implement a new teaching strategy.
words.d: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

t: 分散， 赶散； 消散， 驱散 (vi.)
使分散，散开；使消散，消失 (vt.)
words.s: I watched the people disperse in all directions to avoid the charging bull.
words.d: To disperse means to scatter everywhere.

t: 防止， 避免； 转移 (vt.)
想象， 幻想； 想象的产物 (n.)
words.s: He lives in a world of fantasy.
words.sz: 他住在一個奇幻世界裡。
words.d: A fantasy is a pleasant situation that people think about but is unlikely to happen.

t: 装运， 装船； 装载的货物 (n.)
words.s: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
words.sz: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

t: 恶毒的， 凶残的； 剧烈的， 严重的 (adj.)
words.s: The vicious dog tried to bite the small child.
words.d: When something or someone is vicious, they are violent and cruel.

t: 网眼花边，透孔织品；鞋带，系带 (n.)
用系带束紧 (vt.)
巨大的， 庞大的 (adj.)
words.s: My dog looks enormous next to yours.
words.d: Enormous people or things are very large.

t: 外部的， 外面的 (adj.)
words.s: Save it on the external hard drive.
words.sz: 把它保存在外接式硬碟。
words.d: When something is external, it is connected to an outer part.

t: 华丽的， 灿烂的， 绚丽的； 令人十分愉快的， 极好的 (adj.)
words.s: The girl picked out a gorgeous dress to wear to the dance.
words.d: When something is gorgeous, it is very pleasing and attractive.

t: 情况，条件，境遇； (n.)
words.s: There were many circumstances behind their success, like hard work.
words.d: A circumstance is an event that makes a situation what it is.

t: 官方； 权力； 当权者， 行政管理机构； 权威， 专家 (n.)
words.s: He gave me authority to fire them.
words.sz: 他授權給我解僱了他們。
words.d: An authority is someone who has the power to make decisions and enforce rules and laws.

t: 腐蚀， 侵蚀， 磨损； 削弱， 减少 (n.)
words.s: Canyons are formed because rivers of fast-moving water caused erosion.
words.d: Erosion is the destruction of rock or soil due to flowing water or weather.

t: 渐渐上升，升高 (vi.)
攀登， 登上 (vt.)
假如， 若是 (conj.)
words.s: I don't mind lending you the money provided you pay it back within a month.
words.sz: 假如能一个月之内还上的话，我可以把钱借给你。

t: 仪器， 工具； 乐器 (n.)
words.s: Do you play any instrument other than the piano?
words.sz: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？
words.d: An instrument is something designed to do a certain task like play music.

t: 中等的 (adj.)
媒质，媒介物；传导体 (n.)
必不可少的， 必需的 (adj.)
words.s: Water is indispensable to life.
words.sz: 水是生命所不可缺少的。

t: 透镜， 镜片； 镜头 (n.)
words.s: I'm looking for my contact lens.
words.sz: 我在找我的隱形眼鏡。

t: 代表， 表现， 体现； 包括； 包含； 收录 (vt.)
words.s: Mother Teresa was said to embody goodness and kindness.
words.d: To embody means to symbolize or represent something.

t: 致命的， 灾难性的， 毁灭性的； 重大的， 决定性的 (adj.)
words.s: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.
words.sz: 有时候口误对政治家来说是致命的。
words.d: Something that is fatal results in someone’s death.

t: 动机， 目的 (n.)
words.s: Jealousy was the motive for the murder.
words.sz: 嫉妒是謀殺的動機。
words.d: Your motive is your reason for doing something.

t: 想象， 设想 (vt.)
摔跤； 斗争， 搏斗 (n.)
words.s: Do you wrestle?
words.sz: 你摔角嗎？
words.d: To wrestle is to try to push another competitor to the floor.

t: 作为…的动机； 激励， 激发 (vt.)
微小的， 少量的； 不重要的； 仅以微弱多数票获胜的； 记在页边的， 有旁注的 (adj.)
变质 (vi.)
损坏，糟蹋；宠坏，溺爱 (vt.)
战利品， 掠夺物 (n.)
words.s: I don't want to spoil the ending for you.
words.sz: 我不想把結局提前透露給你。
words.d: To spoil is to rot or to make bad.

t: 增加， 繁殖； 乘 (v.)
words.s: In the past year, the number of people at work has multiplied by ten percent.
words.d: To multiply is to increase in number.

t: 牧草地，牧场 (n.)
放牧 (vt.)
words.s: That pasture is ten acres.
words.sz: 那個牧場有十英畝大。
words.d: A pasture is an area of land covered with grass for animals to use as food.

t: 赞成， 同意； 认可， 批准 (n.)
words.s: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
words.sz: 如果您同意,我想給他這份工作。

t: 运动的；流动的；多变的 (adj.)
移动电话 (n.)
words.s: I need to charge my mobile phone.
words.sz: 我需要給手機充電。
words.d: If something is mobile, it can be moved easily.

t: 复合的；多重的，多样的 (adj.)
倍数 (n.)
words.s: When the stunt went wrong, the man suffered multiple injuries.
words.d: If there are multiple things, there are many of them.

t: 进化， 演化； 发展 (n.)

words.s: Our ultimate goal is to establish world peace.
words.sz: 我们的究极目标是树立世界和平。
words.d: When something is ultimate, it is the final result or aim of a long series of events.

t: 使适应； 改编 (vt.)
words.s: I'm slow to adapt to new situations.
words.sz: 我适应新环境很慢。
words.d: To adapt means to change in order to deal with a new situation.

t: 起诉， 告发 (vi.)
对…提起公诉，告发，检举；继续从事 (vt.)
words.s: They were prosecuted for fishing in the river without a permit.
words.d: To prosecute someone means to take legal action against them.

t: 一批， 一组， 一群； 一批生产量 (n.)
长处，优点；价值；功劳，成绩 (n.)
值得， 应受 (vt.)
words.s: The actor received an award for his merits in the movie.
words.d: A merit is a positive or good quality.

t: 口头的； 用言辞的， 用文字的； 动词的 (adj.)
初级律师， 事务律师 (n.)
固有的； 本质的； 内在的 (adj.)
words.s: Paper money has no intrinsic value. It is useful simply because society says it is.
words.d: If something is intrinsic, then it is related to the basic nature of that thing.

t: 接近， 邻近 (n.)
words.s: All the trees in the proximity of the beach had been cut down.
words.d: Proximity is closeness in time, space, or relationships.

t: 发光的， 发亮的； 光明的 (adj.)
将系牢；鞭打，抽打；猛烈打击；猛烈抨击，严厉斥责 (v.)
鞭打； 假睫毛； 鞭梢 (n.)
发票， 收据； 收入， 进款； 收到， 接到 (n.)
words.s: I'd like a receipt, please.
words.sz: 麻煩我要一張收據。
words.d: A receipt is a paper that proves that something was received or bought.

t: 假定， 假设； 臆断； 承担， 担任； 呈现 (vt.)
words.s: Let's assume that'll happen.
words.sz: 讓我們假定那會發生。
words.d: To assume something is to think that it is true, even with no proof.

t: 预先确定； 注定 (vt.)
反复有节奏地喊叫；吟诵，咏唱 (vt.)
反复有节奏的喊叫； 赞美诗， 圣歌 (n.)
命运； 定数， 天命 (n.)
words.s: Everyone ought to be the master of his own destiny.
words.sz: 每個人都應該做自己命運的主人。
words.d: A destiny is all the things that happen or will happen to a person in their life.

t: 胶囊； 航天舱， 密封舱 (n.)
概念， 观念； 设想 (n.)
words.s: I understand the concept.
words.sz: 我明白这概念。
words.d: A concept is an idea about something.

t: 抵抗的； 抗…的， 耐…的 (adj.)
臭氧 (n.)
words.s: The ozone in the stratosphere absorbs ultraviolet radiation.
words.sz: 平流層的臭氧會吸收紫外線。

t: 无限期的； 模糊的， 不确定的 (adj.)
灾难， 灾祸， 天灾； 彻底的失败 (n.)
words.s: It sounds as if he were to blame for the disaster.
words.sz: 听起来好像他是这场灾难的罪魁祸首。
words.d: A disaster is a really bad thing that happens.

t: 生态； 生态学 (n.)
words.s: It was through his influence that she became interested in ecology.
words.sz: 她开始对生态学感兴趣，是受到他的影响。
words.d: Ecology is the study of the environment and living things.

t: 最小的， 最低限度的 (adj.)
words.s: My lazy husband does a minimal amount of work around the house.
words.d: When something is minimal, it is very small.

t: 鸡尾酒； 餐前开胃小吃； 混合物 (n.)
提高， 增加， 加强 (vt.)
words.s: Amy’s blue shirt really enhances the color of her eyes.
words.d: To enhance something is to make it better.

t: 习俗， 惯例； 公约； 会议 (n.)
words.s: In the US, a popular convention is to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.d: A convention is behavior that is considered to be common or polite.

t: 病， 疾病； 不健全， 弊端 (n.)
words.s: The number of people suffering from heart disease has increased.
words.sz: 遭受心脏病困扰的人数增加了。
words.d: A disease is an illness that causes specific problems.

t: 钙 (n.)
尽管 (adv.)
words.s: Notwithstanding your objections, we have decided to move forward with the project.
words.d: We use notwithstanding when we want to show that, although something has been done, it is not enough. A similar term is “in spite of”.

t: 怀疑， 疑心， 猜疑； 一点儿， 少量 (n.)
words.s: The police had a suspicion that the driver had stolen the purse.
words.d: A suspicion is a feeling that something is possible or true in a crime.

t: 买，购买 (vt.)
购买； 购买的物品 (n.)
words.s: You cannot purchase this medicine without a prescription.
words.sz: 那个药的话没有处方是买不到的。

t: 拒绝 (n.)
words.s: I interpreted her silence as a refusal.
words.sz: 我認為她的沉默就是表示拒絕。

t: 可任意使用的 (adj.)
一次性物品， 不回收物品 (n.)
旁道，迂回道 (n.)
绕过， 绕…走； 越过， 置…于不顾 (vt.)
硅 (n.)
清楚， 明晰 (n.)
资金，基金；存款 (n.)
为…提供资金 (vt.)
words.s: We all put money into our club’s fund.
words.d: A fund is an amount of money that people have.

t: 典型的， 有代表性的 (adj.)
words.s: I find that it's typical for him to come too late.
words.sz: 我發現他就是會很晚才來這樣的人。
words.d: If something is typical, it is normal, or something that usually happens.

t: 接受者， 接收者 (n.)
words.s: I was the recipient of four phone calls today.
words.d: A recipient of something is the person who receives it.

t: [C-]英联邦； 联邦， 联合体 (n.)
瓦 (n.)
发出嗡嗡声；忙乱，急行；发出嘈杂的谈话声 (vi.)
嗡嗡声； 嘈杂的谈话声 (n.)
words.s: Seoul buzzes from dawn till dusk.
words.d: To buzz means to show excitement about something.

t: 财政，金融；财源，财务情况 (n.)
为…提供资金 (vt.)
words.s: The government financed the scientist’s experiments with new weapons.
words.d: To finance someone or something means to provide money for them.

t: 招致， 引起； 遭受 (vt.)
臭名昭著的， 声名狼藉的 (adj.)
words.s: This area of town is notorious for gang activity.
words.d: When something is notorious, it is well known because of something bad.

t: 刺杀， 暗杀 (n.)
婴儿的， 幼稚的 (adj.)
婴儿 (n.)
words.s: The infant cried all night.
words.d: An infant is a baby.

t: 腺 (n.)
房屋和地基， 经营场址； 前提， 假设 (n.)
words.s: The premise of the movie that Bobbi and I watched was unrealistic.
words.d: A premise is an idea on which something is based.

t: 马戏， 马戏团； 喧闹的场面； 环形广场 (n.)
words.s: At the age of six, I was taken to a circus for the first time.
words.sz: 在我六岁的时候，我第一次被带去看马戏。
words.d: A circus is a traveling show with animals and people.

t: 引起争论的， 有争议的 (adj.)
words.s: This theory is very controversial.
words.sz: 这个理论很有争议。

t: 达到， 获得； 完成 (vt.)
words.s: If you want to attain a healthy body, you must exercise every day.
words.d: To attain something is to succeed at something or to get something you want.

t: 剥夺， 使丧失 (vt.)
words.s: Because the child was bad, she was deprived of her dessert after dinner.
words.d: To deprive someone of something means to not let them have it.

t: 房客， 佃户 (n.)
words.s: The new tenants moved into the house across the street.
words.d: A tenant is a person who rents property from a landlord.

t: 作为结果的， 因而发生的 (adj.)
有害生物， 害虫； 讨厌的人 (n.)
words.s: Many farmers put up scarecrows to keep pests of their corn.
words.d: A pest is an animal or insect that hurts plants or food.

t: 踩踏板，骑车 (vi.)
踏板，踏脚 (n.)
脚蹬， 踩动…的踏板 (vt.)
连续猛击 (v.)
面糊 (n.)
遗产； 继承物； 传统 (n.)
words.s: Teepees are part of the heritage of the Native Americans of the plains.
words.d: Heritage is the collection of features of a society, such as language and religion.

t: 最高的， 最大的； 极度的， 最重要的 (adj.)
words.s: The supreme officer was in charge of keeping the citizens calm.
words.d: Supreme means of the highest level or best quality.

t: 人质 (n.)
优先， 重点； 优先考虑的事 (n.)
words.s: My priority is to get good grades in school.
words.d: A priority is something that is more important than other things.

t: 倾斜 (v.)
倾斜，斜面 (n.)
words.s: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
words.sz: 這條小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。
words.d: A slope is ground that is not flat.

t: 小湾， 水湾； 进口， 入口 (n.)
金属的， 金属制的； 有金属特性的， 像金属的 (adj.)
穿梭般来回 (vi.)
短程穿梭运行的飞机；航天飞机；梭子 (n.)
短程穿梭运送 (vt.)
新生， 再生， 起革新作用 (vi.)
使新生，重建，改革，革新 (vt.)
分配； 分派， 把…拨给 (vt.)
words.s: The government allocated $100 million to aid the disaster relief effort.
words.d: To allocate something means to put it aside for a certain purpose or person.

t: 潜在的， 隐伏的， 不易察觉的 (adj.)
极妙的； 极大的； 令人恐惧的 (adj.)
words.s: My youngest daughter is a terrific painter.
words.d: Something terrific is very good.

t: 立场， 观点 (n.)
首要的， 主要的； 基本的； 最初的， 初级的 (adj.)
words.s: This problem is too difficult for primary school children to solve.
words.sz: 这个问题让小学生解决太难了。
words.d: If something is primary, it is the most important thing.

t: 非法盗印者，侵犯版权者；海盗 (n.)
盗用， 非法盗印 (vt.)
words.s: Tom was dressed like a pirate.
words.sz: Tom穿得像个海盗。
words.d: A pirate is a sailor who steals things from other boats.

t: 顽固的， 执拗的， 倔强的； 难对付的， 难于克服的 (adj.)
words.s: Facts are stubborn things, but statistics are pliable.
words.sz: 事实是倔强的，但统计是柔顺的。
words.d: Stubborn people don’t change their minds easily.

t: 构想出， 规划； 系统地阐述 (vt.)
消灭， 毁灭 (vi.)
消费；吃完，喝光 (vt.)
words.s: The Swiss consume a large amount of beer.
words.sz: 瑞士人消耗不少啤酒。
words.d: To consume something means to eat or drink it.

t: 圆屋顶， 穹顶 (n.)
words.s: What's the number for the Tokyo Dome?
words.sz: 东京巨蛋的电话号码是多少？
words.d: A dome is a curved roof of a building.

t: 层， 层次 (n.)
words.s: There was a layer of snow on the tops of the houses this morning.
words.d: A layer covers over something or is one of several pieces lying on top of each other.

t: 外国的，外国人的；陌生的；性质不同的，不相容的 (adj.)
外国人， 外侨； 外星人 (n.)
words.d: An alien is a creature from a different world.

t: 能力， 胜任， 称职 (n.)
words.s: The job was easy because the group had enough competence to do it well.
words.d: Competence is the ability to do something well or effectively.

t: 熔合， 合并； 因保险丝熔断而中断工作 (v.)
保险丝，熔丝；导火线 (n.)
words.s: The boy lit the fuse on the rocket and waited for it to burst in the sky.
words.d: A fuse is a string on fireworks that burns to make them explode.

t: [总称] 上层人士， 掌权人物， 实力集团； [总称]出类拔萃的人， 精英 (n.)
words.s: Only an elite group was allowed membership into the club.
words.d: Elite means of or from a high-level group.

t: 高级的，优质的；售价高的 (adj.)
保险金；额外费用，加付款；奖品，赠品；额外津贴 (n.)
words.s: Tony paid a premium for the gas because it made his car run better.
words.d: A premium is a payment that is higher than average.

t: 装饰品，点缀品；装饰，点缀 (n.)
装饰， 点缀， 美化 (vt.)
words.s: The woman kept some colorful ornaments on the shelves.
words.d: An ornament is an attractive object that people display in their homes.

t: 使确信； 确保， 向…保证 (vt.)
words.s: He assured the boss that the building would be done on time.
words.d: To assure people is to tell them something is true to make them less worried.

t: 借口， 托辞 (n.)
words.s: He came to my house on the pretext of seeing me.
words.sz: 他打着见我的幌子来了我家。

t: 象牙； 象牙色， 乳白色 (n.)
words.s: The elephant’s long ivory tusks looked very impressive.
words.d: Ivory is a hard, white substance that comes from elephants.

t: 主题， 题目 (n.)
words.s: What is the theme of his latest novel?
words.sz: 他最后一本小说的主题是什么？
words.d: A theme is the main subject of a book, movie, or painting.

t: 请教； 查阅； 商议 (vt.)
words.s: I don't know who to consult with.
words.sz: 我不知道该和谁商量好。
words.d: To consult means to ask someone for help.

t: 团结一致 (n.)
words.s: All the citizens came together in a show of solidarity to create change.
words.d: Solidarity is a union formed from common responsibilities or interests.

t: 跌倒，摔下，滚下；翻滚；暴跌；不由自主地卷入 (vi.)
跌倒， 摔倒 (n.)
亲切的，和蔼的；优美的；雅致的，雍容华贵的 (adj.)
天哪! (int.)
words.s: She is gracious to everyone.
words.sz: 她对谁都很和蔼可亲。
words.d: If someone is gracious, then they are kind and helpful to those who need it.

t: 猛撞，猛冲 (vi.)
使粉碎，使打烂；狠打，猛击；使破灭，使失败 (vt.)
破碎； 猛击， 猛撞； 轰动的演出， 巨大的成功 (n.)
words.s: Jacob smashed the window with a rock.
words.d: To smash something is to break it into many small pieces.

t: 仅仅， 只不过 (adv.)
words.s: He said it merely as a joke.
words.sz: 他这么说就是为了开玩笑。

t: 据为己有， 占有； 挪用； 拨款 (n.)
矛盾， 不一致； 否认， 反驳 (n.)
财富； 财产； 丰富 (n.)
words.s: Because of his wealth, he was able to become a member of that club.
words.sz: 由於他的財富，他能夠成為這個俱樂部的成員。
words.d: Wealth is the total of one’s possessions (money, land, etc.).

t: 从今以后， 从此以后 (adv.)
皮夹子 (n.)
words.s: My father took out his wallet and gave me ten dollars.
words.sz: 我爸爸拿出他的钱包，并给了我10美元。

t: 活下来，继续存在；幸免于 (vi.)
从中挺过来； 从…逃出； 比…活得长 (vt.)
words.s: A bookstore in that location wouldn't make enough money to survive.
words.sz: 那個地點的書店無法賺足夠的錢生存下去。
words.d: When something survives, it manages to continue to live in spite of difficult circumstances.

t: 想要，渴望 (vt.)
愿望， 欲望 (n.)
words.s: There are no people who don't desire peace.
words.sz: 沒人不渴望和平。
words.d: To desire is to want something.

t: 最初的，开始的 (adj.)
首字母 (n.)
words.s: The initial step when writing a paper is to find a good topic.
words.d: Initial shows that something is first.

t: 效率高的； 有能力的 (adj.)
words.s: There is no denying that she is very efficient.
words.sz: 无可否认她非常有能力。
words.d: If something or someone is efficient, they do not waste energy.

t: 小声说； 小声抱怨， 咕哝； 发出连续而低沉的声音 (n&v.)
words.s: The murmur of the brook lulls me to sleep.
words.sz: 溪流潺潺，催我入眠。

t: 狂怒， 暴怒； 狂暴， 狂烈 (n.)
使联合， 统一； 使相同， 使一致 (vt.)
words.s: He tried to unify the various groups.
words.sz: 他試著統一不同的團體。
words.d: To unify means to bring people or things together.

t: 泥泞的，沾满烂泥的；灰暗的，暗淡的；模糊的，糊涂的 (adj.)
使沾上烂泥； 使显得扑朔迷离 (vt.)
猎犬 (n.)
追逼， 烦恼， 纠缠 (vt.)
words.s: The men took their hounds with them when they went on the hunting trip.
words.d: A hound is a type of dog that is often used for racing or hunting.

t: 坚持的， 一贯的； 一致的， 符合的 (adj.)
words.s: Sara comes in every day and is our most consistent worker.
words.d: If a person is consistent, they always have the same behavior or attitude.

t: 救济，救济金 (n.)
发放， 发给 (vt.)
反向，倒转 (vi.)
反向的； 相反的； 颠倒的 (adj.)
撤销，废除；使完全相反，彻底转变；使反转，使次序颠倒 (vt.)
相反情况，对立面；反面，背面，后面；损失，倒退 (n.)
words.s: He did the reverse of what I asked.
words.sz: 他做的和我要求的相反。
words.d: When a car reverses, it goes backwards.

t: 贫瘠的， 荒芜的； 不结果实的， 不育的； 无益的， 没有结果的 (adj.)
永久的， 永世的； 无休止的； 永恒的， 永不改变的 (adj.)
words.s: Do you believe in eternal life after death?
words.sz: 你相信死后永生吗？

t: 永久的， 固定的 (adj.)
words.s: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.
words.sz: 正式工比临时工要好。
words.d: Something permanent lasts for a long time or forever.

t: 收养的 (adj.)
收养，养育；培养，促进 (vt.)
words.s: This song was written by Foster.
words.sz: 這首歌曲是由福斯特所寫的。
words.d: To foster is to help a skill, feeling, or idea develop over a period of time.

t: 仅仅， 只不过， 几乎不 (adv.)
words.s: Tom always speaks in such a low voice that I can barely understand what he says.
words.sz: 汤姆总是说话声音太小，我几乎听不懂他在说什么。
words.d: Barely means by the smallest amount, almost not.

t: 流行的， 普遍的 (adj.)
words.s: Growing a beard is more prevalent in some countries than in others.
words.d: When something is prevalent, it is common.

t: 紧紧抓住； 黏着， 挨近； 依附， 依恋； 坚持， 墨守， 忠实于 (vi.)
words.s: A mother sloth will cling tightly to her baby in the treetops.
words.d: To cling to something means to hold onto it tightly.

t: 发生率 (n.)
words.s: We need to increase the incidence of success in school.
words.d: The number of times something happens is the incidence of the event.

t: 夹子，回形针，别针；弹夹，弹仓；剪，修剪；剪报，电影片断 (n.)
夹住， 扣住； 剪， 修剪 (vt.)
面露喜色； 定向发出， 播送 (v.)
梁，横梁；束，柱；笑容，喜色 (n.)
words.s: Modern skyscrapers are made with many beams.
words.d: A beam is a heavy bar.

t: 紧凑的，小巧的；坚实的 (adj.)
把…压实，使坚实['kɔmpækt] (vt.)
契约， 合同 (n.)
words.s: She gave me this compact disc.
words.sz: 她給了我這個光碟。

t: 结盟； 联盟 (n.)
words.s: The junior executives formed an alliance with each other.
words.d: An alliance is a group of people who work together.

t: 非常宝贵的， 极为贵重的， 无价的 (adj.)
words.s: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.
words.sz: 互联网是一种无法估量的信息资源。

t: 小说； 虚构， 杜撰 (n.)
words.s: He's very fond of science fiction.
words.sz: 他非常喜欢科幻小说。
words.d: Fiction is a story that is not true.

t: 注定，命定 (vt.)
厄运， 劫数 (n.)
黄瓜 (n.)
航空， 航空学； 飞机制造业 (n.)
悲观的 (adj.)
words.s: Don't be so pessimistic.
words.sz: 不要感觉那么悲观。
words.d: If someone is pessimistic, they believe that the worst will happen.

t: 意思是； 表示， 是…的标志 (vt.)
words.s: Quotation marks are used to denote speech.
words.d: When one thing denotes another, it stands as a sign or substitute for that thing.

t: 强调； 重视； 重要性 (n.)
words.s: He placed emphasis on the importance of education.
words.sz: 他强调了教育的重要性。
words.d: When you put an emphasis on prevention, you give special attention to prevention.

t: 打断， 中止； 打扰 (v.)
words.s: I didn't mean to interrupt anything.
words.sz: 我沒想要打擾什麼事。

t: 繁殖， 增殖； 传播， 宣传， 普及 (v.)
可行的， 可能的 (adj.)
陛下； 雄伟， 壮丽； 庄严 (n.)
words.s: The majesty of the old castle amazed the tourists who came to see it.
words.d: Majesty is supreme greatness or authority.

t: 向…谄媚， 奉承； 使满意， 使感到荣幸； 使显得好看， 使显得突出 (vt.)
words.s: He was just flattering me when he said that my new dress looked gorgeous.
words.d: To fatter people means to praise them in an effort to please them.

t: 潜在的，可能的 (adj.)
潜力， 潜能 (n.)
words.s: Every man is a potential corpse.
words.sz: 每个人都可能变成尸体。
words.d: Potential means capable of being but not yet actual or real.

t: 成为必要， 需要 (vt.)
传统的； 正统的， 正宗的 (adj.)
惯常的， 习惯的 (adj.)
words.s: He quickly accustomed himself to his new surroundings.
words.sz: 他很快就适应了新环境。

t: 结合， 联合； 化合 (n.)
words.s: Jazz fusion is a combination of rock and jazz.
words.sz: 融合爵士是搖滾樂與爵士樂的融合。

t: 通用， 流行； 存在 (vi.)
获得 (vt.)
words.s: After I passed the test, I obtained my driver’s license.
words.d: To obtain is to get something you want or need.

t: 国务活动家， 政治家 (n.)
words.s: The boy grew up to be a great statesman.
words.sz: 这个孩子长大后成为了一个伟大的政治家。

t: 平头钉，大头钉；行动方向，方针 (n.)
用平头钉钉； 附加， 增补 (vt.)
总的； 严重的； 粗俗的； 臃肿的 (adj.)
words.s: The food was so gross that the dog couldn’t eat it without feeling sick.
words.d: If something is gross, then it is disgusting.

t: 倚，躺；闲逛，闲荡 (vi.)
休息厅， 休息室 (n.)
门廊 (n.)
车间， 工场； 专题讨论会 (n.)
words.s: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.
words.sz: 我把车库改造成车间使用。

t: 设计，安排；格式，样式，版式 (n.)
使格式化 (vt.)
牺牲， 舍身； 献祭， 供奉； 祭品 (n&v.)
words.s: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
words.sz: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？
words.d: To sacrifice is to give up something in order to get something you want or do something else for someone.

t: 不合法的， 非法的 (adj.)
words.s: In Canada, there are many areas where it is illegal to log trees.
words.sz: 在加拿大有很多區域砍伐樹木是非法的。

t: 队， 部队； 一组 (n.)
words.s: The army had a corps of archers who trained apart from the regular soldiers.
words.d: A corps is a division of a military force.

t: 食；消失，黯然失色 (n.)
食， 遮掩光； 使暗淡， 使失色， 使相形见绌 (vt.)
words.s: Did you see the eclipse yesterday?
words.sz: 你看了昨天的月蝕了嗎？

t: 正式的； 礼仪上的 (adj.)
words.s: There's no need for you to prepare a formal speech.
words.sz: 您没必要准备一个正式的演讲。
words.d: A formal thing is official or serious.

t: 相关， 关联 (vi.)
使相互关联 (vt.)
words.s: Scientists believe that brain size might correlate with intelligence.
words.d: To correlate is to have a close connection to something.

t: 猛增， 剧增； 高飞， 升腾； 高涨； 高耸， 屹立 (vi.)
words.s: The temperature today will soar to a high of 100 degrees Fahrenheit.
words.d: To soar is to increase quickly to a high level.

t: 乘公交车上下班，经常乘车往返于两地 (vi.)
减； 折合， 折偿； 上下班交通 (vt.)
words.s: Do you commute to school by bus?
words.sz: 你搭公車上下學嗎？
words.d: To commute is to travel a long distance to get to work.

t: 保持， 使持续下去； 供养， 维持； 支持， 支撑； 经受， 遭受 (vt.)
words.s: Wind power is a clean way to sustain a city with energy.
words.d: To sustain something is to keep it going.

t: 决定性的； 批评的 (adj.)
words.s: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.
words.sz: 我不明白为什么你这么批评他。

t: 牧羊人，羊倌 (n.)
带领， 引导 (vt.)
words.s: The shepherd moved the sheep to another field.
words.d: A shepherd is a person who protects and cares for sheep.

t: 大声疾呼， 呐喊； 强烈抗议 (n.)
容光焕发的， 喜形于色的； 光芒四射的， 光辉灿烂的； 辐射的 (adj.)
最重要的，主要的 (adj.)
负责人， 校长； 资本， 本金； 主要演员， 主角 (n.)
words.s: Our school's principal is very old.
words.sz: 我校校长很老了。
words.d: A principal is a person in charge of a school.

t: 极端地， 非常 (adv.)
支持， 维护 (vt.)
外来的， 异国情调的； 奇异的 (adj.)
words.s: Rebecca tried many exotic foods on her trip to Africa.
words.d: Exotic describes something unusual because it is from far away.

t: 轻松， 宽慰； 缓解， 减轻， 解除； 使得到调剂； 接替， 替下 (n.)
words.s: This medicine will give you some relief.
words.sz: 这药会让你舒服些。
words.d: Relief is a good feeling after something bad or challenging ends.

t: 抵制， 拒绝参与 (n&vt.)
尺寸， 尺度， 面积； 方面， 特点； 面积， 规模 (n.)
应受， 值得 (vt.)
words.s: You don't deserve the salary they're paying you.
words.sz: 你不应该得到他们给你的薪水。
words.d: To deserve is to be worthy of something as a result of one’s actions.

t: 过程；制作方法；程序 (n.)
加工， 办理 (vt.)
words.s: The whole process will take months.
words.sz: 整个过程需要耗费数月。
words.d: A process is the steps to take to do something.

t: 报复，报仇 (n.)
为…报仇， 报…之仇 (vt.)
words.s: They set fire to their neighbor's house in revenge.
words.sz: 為了報仇，他們放火燒了鄰居的家。
words.d: Revenge is the act of hurting someone who has hurt you.

t: 恢复， 使恢复； 修复， 整修； 归还， 交还 (vt.)
words.s: Victor restored the old car.
words.d: To restore something is to put it back the way it was.

t: 订阅，订购；同意，赞成 (vi.)
捐助， 赞助 (vt.)
words.s: What newspaper do you subscribe to?
words.sz: 你訂閱了什麼報紙?
words.d: To subscribe to something is to agree with it.

t: 蒸馏， 用蒸馏法提取； 吸取， 提炼 (vt.)
两者选一的， 供选择的； 另类的 (adj.)
替换物，选择；选择的自由 (n.)
words.s: Her first plan to make extra money seemed weak, so she chose an alternative.
words.d: An alternative is something that you can choose instead of your first choice.

t: 集中； 专注， 专心； 浓缩； 浓度 (n.)
速度， 速率 (n.)
遭遇，遇到 (vt.)
遭遇 (n.)
words.s: I encountered a sea turtle while I was swimming.
words.d: To encounter is to find or meet a person or thing.

t: 伙伴关系， 交情， 友谊； 团体， 协会， 联谊会； 奖学金， 研究员职位 (n.)
同事， 同僚 (n.)
words.s: I'm a colleague of Tom's.
words.sz: 我是汤姆的一位同事。
words.d: A colleague is somebody you work with.

t: 赞成， 称许 (vi.)
赞成，称许；批准 (vt.)
words.s: That's why I don't approve of your plan.
words.sz: 那就是我不赞同你的计划的原因。
words.d: To approve of something means you like or agree with that thing.

t: 相互作用 (n.)
步行者， 行人 (n.)
words.s: Drivers should be careful when pedestrians are walking around.
words.d: A pedestrian is a person who is walking on a street.

t: 干涉， 干预， 妨碍 (vi.)
words.s: You have no right to interfere in other people's affairs.
words.sz: 你沒有干涉他人事務的權力。
words.d: To interfere is to cause problems and keep something from happening.

t: 一套公寓房间 (n.)
words.s: We have a warrant to search your apartment.
words.sz: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。
words.d: An apartment is a set of rooms in a building where people live.

t: 说明…的原因； 占… (vi.)
记述；解释；账目 (n.)
words.s: We must take into account the wishes of all the family in planning a trip.
words.sz: 筹划旅行的时候，我们必须考虑到全家人的意愿。
words.d: An account with a bank is an arrangement to keep one’s money there.

t: 适合的， 恰当的 (adj.)
设备，家具，日用器具；配件，附件，零件；试穿，试衣 (n.)
words.s: I'd like to try this on. Where are the fitting rooms?
words.sz: 我想试试这件。请问哪里是试衣间？

t: 堆，垛 (n.)
堆积， 堆放于 (vt.)
words.s: Tom put a stack of letters on Mary's desk.
words.sz: 湯姆把一疊信放在瑪麗桌上。
words.d: A stack is a pile of different things.

t: 放射性的， 有辐射能的 (adj.)
words.s: Radioactive states can be very bad for anyone’s health.
words.d: If something is radioactive, then it lets out, or is related to, radiation.

t: 对…表示愤恨， 怨恨 (vt.)
words.s: Why do you resent me?
words.sz: 你为什么恨我？
words.d: To resent something means to have bad feelings about it.

t: 大踏步走 (vi.)
大步； 步法， 步态； 进展， 进步 (n.)
引起歧义的， 模棱两可的， 含糊不清的 (adj.)
words.s: This sentence is ambiguous.
words.sz: 此句有歧義
words.d: If something is ambiguous, it is not entirely clear.

t: 冲动的 (adj.)
性质的， 定性的 (adj.)
不一样的， 相异的； 多种多样的 (adj.)
words.s: Big cities have diverse populations with people of different races and ages.
words.d: When a group of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

t: 脆的，鲜脆的；挺括的；清新的，干冷的；简明扼要的，利落的 (adj.)
油炸土豆片 (n.)
words.s: My favorite snack is a bag of crisp, delicious potato chips.
words.d: When food is crisp, it is hard or has a hard surface in a way that is pleasant.

t: 首要的；最好的 (adj.)
青春；全盛时期 (n.)
使准备好 (vt.)
words.s: The Prime Minister's speech was calculated to anger the opposition parties.
words.sz: 總理的發言估計激怒了在野黨。
words.d: Prime shows that something is the most important one.

t: 智力， 理解力； 才智非凡的人 (n.)
words.s: She was known for her quick and strong intellect as well as her beauty.
words.d: An intellect is a person’s ability to understand things easily.

t: 喜爱， 偏爱； 优先； 偏爱的事物 (n.)
温柔的； 温暖的； 轻微的 (adj.)
words.s: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
words.sz: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。

t: 忠诚的， 忠心的 (adj.)
words.s: The three friends are very loyal to each other.
words.d: Loyal people always help or support a certain person or thing.

t: 影响， 作用， 冲击 (v.)
[Im'pækt] (n.)
words.s: My grandmother had a great impact on my life.
words.d: An impact is the effect someone or something has.

t: 麻痹， 瘫痪， 中风； 无能， 无力 (n.)
words.s: His paralysis meant that he had to use a wheelchair to get around.
words.d: Paralysis is the loss of the ability to move all or part of your body.

t: 法院， 法庭； 庭院； 宫廷； 球场 (n.)
words.s: Anything you say may be held against you in a court of law.
words.sz: 你所说的一切都将成为呈堂证供。

t: 小教堂， 祈祷室 (n.)
words.s: We were married in a small wedding chapel in Las Vegas.
words.d: A chapel is a building where people go to pray and worship God.

t: 变形 (vi.)
歪曲，曲解；扭曲，使变形 (vt.)
words.s: The man’s lawyer distorted the facts so that he would be set free.
words.d: To distort something means to lie about it, or pull or twist out of shape.

t: 辅助的，次要的，附设的 (adj.)
子公司， 附属机构 (n.)
冒险； 大胆行事 (vi.)
风险投资，风险项目 (n.)
拿…冒险；敢于 (vt.)
words.s: Even though it was dangerous, they ventured up the mountain.
words.d: To venture is to go to a place that may be dangerous.

t: 看出， 察觉出； 识别， 认出 (vt.)
热情， 热心， 热忱； 巨大兴趣 (n.)
words.s: Tom doesn't share Mary's enthusiasm.
words.sz: 汤姆没有感受到玛丽的热情。
words.d: Enthusiasm is a very strong good feeling about something.

t: 易弯曲的； 灵活的 (adj.)
words.s: The tree branch was so flexible it could be bent into a circle and not break.
words.d: If something is flexible, then it can bend easily without breaking.

t: 领域， 范围； 领地， 势力范围 (n.)
人口普查， 统计 (n.)
死尸， 尸体 (n.)
words.s: Every man is a potential corpse.
words.sz: 每个人都可能变成尸体。

t: 故意的， 特意的 (adj.)
态度， 看法； 姿势 (n.)
words.s: You can't fight a good fight with such a defeatist attitude.
words.sz: 抱著失敗主義的態度你無法打一場漂亮的仗。
words.d: Someone’s attitude is the way they feel and think.

t: 有关系的，相对的 (adj.)
亲属， 亲戚 (n.)
words.s: Tom is a distant relative of mine.
words.sz: 湯姆是我的遠亲。
words.d: A relative is a family member.

t: 比较， 对照； 把…比作 (vt.)
words.s: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
words.sz: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
words.d: To compare means to say how two things are the same and different.

t: 描绘， 描述 (vt.)
words.s: The statue’s face depicted the general’s determination and courage.
words.d: To depict something means to show or portray it, often using art.

t: 单足跳跃，单足跳行；齐足跳跃，齐足跳行 (vi.)
跳上 (vt.)
蹦跳； 短程航行 (n.)
words.s: The kangaroo quickly hopped away from danger.
words.d: To hop means to jump a short distance.

t: 特有的，典型的 (adj.)
特性 (n.)
words.s: I got over the difficulty with my characteristic tenacity.
words.sz: 我凭韧性克服了困难。
words.d: A characteristic is something that shows what a person or a thing is like.

t: 连累； 包含 (n.)
铺， 铺筑 (vt.)
构成整体所必需的， 基本的 (adj.)
words.s: She is an integral member of our team.
words.d: Something that is integral is an important part of the whole.

t: 使润滑 (vt.)
彗星 (n.)
words.s: Comets take many decades to complete an orbit around a star.
words.d: A comet is an object in space made of ice and rock with a tail of glowing dust.

t: 最后期限 (n.)
words.s: You must get the job done before the deadline.
words.sz: 你必须在到期前完成这项工作。
words.d: A deadline is the time by which you need to have something completed.

t: 恃强欺弱者 (n.)
威吓， 欺负 (vt.)
words.s: The two bullies always picked on the smaller, weaker kids.
words.d: A bully is a person who is mean to others.

t: 屑片， 碎片； 炸土豆条； 集成电路片， 集成块； 缺口， 瑕疵 (n.)
words.s: Tom baked some chocolate chip cookies.
words.sz: 汤姆烤了些巧克力脆饼。

t: 中世纪的； 中古的 (adj.)
words.s: We visited a castle that was built during medieval times.
words.d: If something is medieval, it comes from the period between 650 and 1500 CE.

t: 油轮 (n.)
使卷入， 牵涉； 包含， 含有 (vt.)
words.s: I didn't mean to involve you.
words.sz: 我沒想要讓你牽扯進來。
words.d: To involve means to include as an active participant.

t: 手枪 (n.)
words.s: Give me your pistol.
words.sz: 把槍給我。

t: 集合，召集 (vi.)
集合， 聚集； 装配 (vt.)
words.s: This bookcase is easy to assemble.
words.sz: 這個書架組裝起來很簡單。
words.d: To assemble means to get together in one place.

t: 不透水的， 防水的； 严密的， 无懈可击的 (adj.)
过渡， 转变 (n.)
words.s: The weather gets colder during the transition from summer to autumn.
words.d: A transition is a process where there is a change from one form to another.

t: 使厌恶； 击退， 逐回， 驱除； 排斥 (vt.)
轻声低语； 小声抱怨 (n&v.)
一系列， 连续； 丛书， 连续剧 (n.)
words.s: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
words.sz: 他刚发表一系列有趣的文章。

t: 复杂的， 难懂的 (adj.)
words.s: Computers are capable of doing extremely complicated work.
words.sz: 电脑可以做极为复杂的工作。

t: 废旧物品，破烂 (n.)
丢弃， 废弃 (vt.)
words.s: Tom has no idea what to do with all the junk in his garage.
words.sz: 汤姆不知道拿他车库的那些废物怎么办。

t: 最大的； 最高的； 顶点的 (adj.)
最大量；顶点 (n.)
words.s: The maximum driving speed here is 80 km/h.
words.d: Maximum is the highest amount of anything allowed.

t: 兴旺， 繁荣， 旺盛 (vi.)
words.s: He may be an old man, but he continues to thrive.
words.d: To thrive means to do well and be successful, healthy, or strong.

t: 富有想象力的， 爱想象的 (adj.)
words.s: He used to be an imaginative boy.
words.sz: 他曾經是一個富有想像力的男孩。

t: 企鹅 (n.)
作为…的代表， 表示， 象征； 描绘， 表现 (vt.)
words.s: The blue lines on the map represent rivers.
words.sz: 地图上的蓝线代表河流。
words.d: To represent is to speak or act for a person or group.

t: 杰作 (n.)
words.s: I think that Liszt's "Forgotten Waltz No.3" is a hidden masterpiece.
words.sz: 我觉得李斯特的《被遗忘的圆舞曲第三首》是个被埋没的名曲。
words.d: A masterpiece is a very good painting, novel, movie, or other work of art.

t: 比赛， 竞争， 对抗 (vi.)
宽容的， 容忍的 (adj.)
words.s: The tolerant leader thought that everyone was equal regardless of race.
words.d: When people are tolerant, they are respectful of others’ rights and beliefs.

t: 派遣，调遣，发送 (vt.)
急件， 快信； 新闻报道； 派遣， 调遣 (n.)
紧急情况， 突然事件 (n.)
words.s: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
words.sz: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
words.d: An emergency is a time when someone needs help right away.

t: 昏暗的，朦胧的；模糊不清的 (adj.)
变暗淡 (v.)
words.s: I have a dim memory of my grandmother.
words.sz: 我对祖母的记忆很模糊。

t: 使瘫痪， 使麻痹； 使丧失作用； 使惊愕， 使呆若木鸡 (vt.)
人与人之间的， 关于人与人之间关系的 (adj.)
可作楷模的， 典范的 (adj.)
才能， 能力； 系， 科； 全体教员 (n.)
words.s: The boy’s mental faculties impressed all of his teachers.
words.d: A faculty is a mental or physical ability.

t: 解雇； 裁员； 歇工期， 停工期 (n.)
极不愉快的， 难受的， 可怜的； 令人苦恼的， 讨厌的； 拙劣的 (adj.)
荒谬的， 荒唐的 (adj.)
words.s: That's the most absurd idea I've ever heard.
words.sz: 这是我听过最荒谬的想法。
words.d: If something or someone is absurd, they are ridiculous.

t: 谦虚 (n.)
words.s: His modesty is worth respecting.
words.sz: 他的謙遜值得尊敬。

t: 考虑周到的， 体贴的， 体谅的 (adj.)
words.s: You were considerate not to disturb us.
words.sz: 你考虑周到，没有打扰我们。
words.d: When someone is considerate, they pay attention to the needs of others.

t: 魅力， 诱惑力 (n.)
线索， 暗示， 提示 (n.)
words.s: I have no clue.
words.sz: 我一无所知。
words.d: A clue is a fact or object that helps solve a mystery or crime.

t: 括号；等级段，档次；壁架，托架 (n.)
把…置于括号内； 把…归入同一类 (vt.)
法律的； 合法的 (adj.)
words.s: The legal system in America is the world's finest.

t: 代替人，代用品 (n.)
用…代替 (vt.)
words.s: When I ran out of juice, I had to substitute water to drink in the morning.
words.d: To substitute something or someone means to have them take the place of another.

t: 抵押，抵押借款 (n.)
抵押 (vt.)
words.s: When they bought their new home, the married couple had to sign a mortgage.
words.d: A mortgage is a loan for property, especially a home or a business.

t: 熊熊燃烧，着火；发光，放光彩；迸发，爆发 (vi.)
火焰， 烈火； 光辉， 强烈的光； 迸发， 爆发； 灿烂， 炫耀 (n.)
words.s: The small fire soon blazed into a large, dangerous one.
words.d: To blaze means to burn brightly or powerfully.

t: 而且， 再者， 此外 (adv.)
words.s: Marianne likes to walk to work to save money; moreover, it is good exercise.
words.d: Moreover is used to introduce information that adds to or supports what has previously been said.

t: 撒， 散播； 使散开， 驱散 (vt.)
words.s: I accidentally scattered all of my pills.
words.d: To scatter something is to make it go in many places.

t: 违反， 违背； 亵渎； 侵犯， 妨碍 (vt.)
words.s: I was given a ticket because the policeman said I violated a traffic law.
words.d: To violate a law, rule, or agreement means to break it.

t: 联邦的， 联盟的 (adj.)
words.s: Sometimes federal laws are different from state laws.
words.d: If something is federal, it relates to the government of a country.

t: 证实， 查证， 证明 (vt.)
words.s: I can verify that that's the truth myself.
words.sz: 我自己能够证实那是真的。
words.d: To verify means to find out if something is true.

t: 远足， 短途旅行 (n.)
开始， 开展； 为…举行就职典礼； 为…举行开幕式， 为…举行落成仪式 (vt.)
经历； 经受， 忍受 (vt.)
words.s: The cancer patient undergoes treatments twice a week.
words.d: To undergo an action means to have it happen to you.

t: 报答，奖赏；报酬，酬金 (n.)
报答， 酬谢， 奖励 (vt.)
words.s: He is entitled to receive the reward.
words.sz: 他有权得到奖励。
words.d: A reward is something given in exchange for good behavior or work.

t: 吃青草 (vi.)
放牧；擦伤；擦过，掠过 (vt.)
擦破 (n.)
words.s: The sheep and goats like to graze on the grass outside the village.
words.d: When animals graze, they feed on plants.

t: 礼券， 优惠券； 配给券， 票证 (n.)
大量， 许多； 大众， 民众 (n.)
words.s: A multitude of people were waiting at the airport.
words.d: A multitude of things or people is a very large number of them.

t: 居住于， 栖居于 (vt.)
words.s: No one inhabits the ancient city.
words.d: To inhabit means to live in a certain place.

t: 包围， 围困 (n.)
抽象的，抽象派的 (adj.)
摘要，梗概；抽象派艺术作品 (n.)
words.s: Some abstract art is difficult to understand.
words.sz: 一些抽象藝術是很難理解的。
words.d: An abstract thing is an idea or thought, not a physical thing.

t: 议程 (n.)
words.s: Let's proceed with the items on the agenda.
words.sz: 讓我們繼續進行議程上的項目。
words.d: An agenda is a plan or goal that guides someone’s behavior.

t: 衰退，堕落，蜕化 (vi.)
衰退的，堕落的 (adj.)
堕落者 (n.)
养育， 培育， 滋养 (n&vt.)
words.s: Robert nurtured his plants, and that is why they grow so well.
words.d: To nurture something means to care for it as it grows or develops.

t: 破坏的， 毁灭的 (adj.)
出现， 来到； 外观 (n.)
words.s: Judging from his appearance, he must be a rich man.
words.sz: 从他的外表来看，他应该是个有钱人。

t: 文化， 文明； 教养； 培养； 培养菌 (n.)
words.s: The students are talking about language and culture.
words.sz: 学生们在探讨语言和文化。
words.d: Culture is the music, art, and writings of a certain place or group of people.

t: 父权， 父子关系 (n.)
草率的， 轻率的； 急速的， 匆忙的， 仓促完成的 (adj.)
words.s: Don't do anything hasty.
words.sz: 不要慌張喔。

t: 无名的， 不具名的； 匿名的； 无特色的， 无个性特征的 (adj.)
words.s: You want to remain anonymous.
words.sz: 你想保持匿名身份。
words.d: If someone is anonymous, no one knows who he or she is.

t: 假的，伪造的 (adj.)
假货；骗子 (n.)
伪造， 捏造； 伪装 (vt.)
words.s: I think Tom is going to be pretty mad when he finds out that the painting he bought is a fake.
words.sz: 我觉得当汤姆发现他买来的画是赝品的时候，他会很生气。
words.d: A fake thing is made to look real in order to trick people.

t: 跨距，一段时间 (n.)
持续， 贯穿， 包括； 横跨， 跨越 (vt.)
words.s: The life span of a butterfly is short.
words.sz: 蝴蝶的寿命短。
words.d: To span is to spread across an amount of time or space.

t: 护卫者，护送者 (n.)
护送， 护卫 (vt.)
words.s: Her bodyguards escorted her to the movie theater.
words.d: To escort people means to safely accompany them to a place.

t: 奇形怪状的， 怪诞的 (adj.)
words.s: What a bizarre story!
words.sz: 多么荒唐的故事！
words.d: When something is bizarre, it is very strange.

t: 存在， 实在； 生存 (n.)
words.s: Do you believe in the existence of ghosts?
words.sz: 你相信有幽灵吗？

t: 把…归因于， 把…归属于 (vt.)
门槛， 门口； 入门， 开端， 起始点 (n.)
浮动， 漂浮， 飘动 (v.)
words.s: Oil will float on water.
words.sz: 油漂浮在水上。
words.d: To float is to move on top of water without sinking.

t: 少数； 少数民族 (n.)
轴， 轴线， 中心线； 坐标轴， 基准线 (n.)
杆； 极， 磁极， 电极 (n.)
words.s: The flag was hanging from the flag pole.
words.d: A pole is a long thin stick made of wood or metal that supports things.

t: 更可取的， 更好的， 更合意的 (adj.)
提到， 论及； 参考， 查阅； 引文； 参考书目； 证明书， 推荐信 (n.)
words.s: My supervisor made a reference to the data I’d collected.
words.d: A reference is the act of referring to something or someone.

t: 恶意，怨恨；不顾 (n.)
刁难， 欺侮 (vt.)
words.s: In spite of the heavy rain, he visited his friend in the hospital.
words.sz: 尽管雨下得很大，但他还是去医院看望他的朋友了。
words.d: Spite is the desire to be mean.

t: 被告 (n.)
words.s: The defendant will appeal to a higher court.
words.sz: 被告会向上级法院上诉。

t: 安排， 准备； 整理 (v.)
words.s: I'll arrange for someone to pick you up at your home.
words.sz: 我会安排一下，叫个人去你家接你。
words.d: To arrange things is to put them in the right place.

t: 橄榄， 橄榄树 (n.)
words.s: I prepared a bowl of olives for my guests.
words.d: An olive is a small egg-shaped black or green fruit.

t: 粗的， 粗糙的； 粗劣的； 粗俗的 (adj.)
words.s: The coarse sweater made my skin itch.
words.d: If something is coarse, that means it has a rough texture.

t: 夸大， 夸张 (v.)
words.s: It seems to me that she has a tendency to exaggerate.
words.sz: 在我看來，她有一種誇張的傾向。
words.d: To exaggerate is to say that something is bigger or better than it really is.

t: 使成流线型； 精简， 使效率更高 (vt.)
暗示， 意指 (vt.)
words.s: I didn't mean to imply otherwise.
words.sz: 我沒想要暗示其他事。
words.d: To imply something is to suggest it without saying it.

t: 补偿， 抵消 (vt.)
words.s: Increased wages are offset by higher prices for goods.
words.d: To offset means to use one thing to cancel out the effect of another thing.

t: 承诺， 许诺， 保证； 信奉， 献身； 承担的义务 (n.)
洞， 穴， 凹处； 龋洞 (n.)
words.s: There was a small cavity in the wall of the cave, where an animal lived.
words.d: A cavity is a hole or space in something.

t: 胆小鬼， 懦夫 (n.)
words.s: She resented being called a coward.
words.sz: 她對被稱為懦夫很反感。
words.d: A coward is a person who lacks courage to do risky or dangerous things.

t: 化石； 食古不化的人， 老顽固 (n.)
words.s: What I have in my hand is a fossil seashell.
words.sz: 在我手裡的是一個貝殼化石。
words.d: A fossil is the hard remains of a prehistoric animal or plant.

t: 伸出，突出 (vi.)
戳，捅；用…戳，把…戳向；伸出，突出 (vt.)
戳， 捅 (n.)
words.s: I poked my finger on a thumb tack.
words.d: To poke something is to push something quickly with your finger or a pointed object.

t: 拒绝 (n.)
固定装置； 固定在某位置的人 (n.)
制造，加工 (vt.)
制造， 制造业 (n.)
words.s: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.
words.sz: 生产日期在盖子上。
words.d: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory.

t: 碰撞； 冲突， 抵触 (n.)
words.s: The collision between the two cars created a loud noise.
words.d: A collision is the act of two things hitting into each another.

t: 连续， 接续， 一连串； 次序， 顺序 (n.)
words.s: The dominos fell in a sequence of one after another.
words.d: A sequence is a number of events or things that come one after another.

t: 招募， 吸收 (vt.)
words.s: We successfully recruited someone to be the new manager.
words.d: To recruit people means to select them to join or work for an organization.

t: 供应； 准备， 预备； 条款， 规定； 给养， 口粮 (n.)
words.s: That department is responsible for the provision of emergency supplies.
words.d: The provision of something is the act of giving it to people in need or want.

t: 大卡； 卡 (n.)
words.s: My sister is on a low-calorie diet for fitness training.
words.d: A calorie is a unit of heat used to measure how much energy a food will produce.

t: 标语， 口号； 广告语 (n.)
不变地， 始终如一地， 总是 (adv.)
开始 (v.)
words.s: His speech commenced with a “thank you” to all who had helped him succeed.
words.d: To commence something means to begin it.

t: 传单， 小册子； 大片 (n.)
words.s: On the other side of the mountains, there was a long tract of forest.
words.d: A tract is a large area of land.

t: 配置， 布局， 构造 (n.)
水银， 汞 (n.)
words.s: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
words.sz: 水星是我們的太陽系中最小的行星。

t: 时常发生的， 常见的 (adj.)
words.s: Except for the bad weather and the frequent earthquakes, this is almost a perfect place to live.
words.sz: 這裡除了惡劣的天氣和頻繁的地震之外，幾乎就是一個完美的居住地。
words.d: If something is frequent, then it happens or is done often.

t: 厚片， 大块； 相当大的部分 (n.)
words.s: When they broke open the rock, they saw it was filled with chunks of gold.
words.d: A chunk is a thick, solid piece of something.

t: 相互作用， 相互影响 (vi.)
words.s: The kids began to interact when the adults left the room.
words.d: To interact is to talk to or do something with another person.

t: 普通的，平庸的 (adj.)
寻常的事物， 平庸的东西 (n.)
words.s: There is nothing commonplace about the way Morris dresses.
words.d: If something is commonplace, then it is ordinary.

t: 总计的， 合计的 (adj.)
总数，合计 (n.)
总计达， 合计； 使聚集， 使积聚 (vt.)
words.s: The company totaled its aggregate sales for the entire year.
words.d: When something is aggregate, it is made up of smaller amounts added together.

t: 表面上， 看上去 (adv.)
伴随的， 随之产生的 (adj.)
服务人员，侍者，随从 (n.)
words.s: Tom is a flight attendant.
words.sz: 湯姆是空服員。

t: 展示；陈列，一系列；排列，队形；衣服，盛装； (n.)
words.s: The toy cars are available in an array of colors.
words.d: An array is a large group or number of things.

t: 界限， 范围； 参数 (n.)
灭绝的， 绝种的； 不再活跃的， 熄灭了的， 已废弃的 (adj.)
words.s: Dinosaurs became extinct a very long time ago.
words.sz: 恐龍在很久以前滅絶了。
words.d: If plants or animals are extinct, there are none left.

t: 区别， 辨别； 有差别地对待， 歧视 (vi.)
words.s: I don't discriminate.
words.sz: 我不歧视人。

t: 降低…的身份， 有辱…的人格； 使降解， 使退化 (vt.)
不透明的， 不透光的； 难理解的， 晦涩的 (adj.)
归还； 报答 (vt.)
words.s: I must repay the debt.
words.sz: 我得還債。
words.d: To repay is to pay back or to reward someone or something.

t: 钱的， 货币的； 金融的 (adj.)
words.s: A strong monetary policy is important for a country to be successful.
words.d: When something is monetary, it relates to money.

t: 严重的， 严肃的 (adj.)
坟墓 (n.)
words.s: She carried that habit to her grave.
words.sz: 她到死都改不了那個習慣。
words.d: A grave is the place where a dead person is buried.

t: 优点， 优势； 好处 (n.)
words.s: She took full advantage of her stay in London to improve her English.
words.sz: 她充分利用她住在伦敦的优势，提高英语。

t: 争论， 辩论 (n.)
words.s: There has been a lot of controversy over the judge’s decision.
words.d: A controversy is a dispute about something that affects many people.

t: 命令， 指挥； 控制 (n&vt.)
words.s: She has a good command of English though she was brought up in Japan.
words.sz: 雖然她在日本被撫養長大，但是她精通英語。
words.d: A command is an order given to a person or animal to do something.

t: 必须做的， 强制性的； 必修的 (adj.)
演出； 履行， 执行， 完成； 工作情况， 表现， 工作性能 (n.)
words.s: What time is the next performance?
words.sz: 下一場表演在幾點鐘？
words.d: Performance is how well someone or something functions, works, etc.

t: 连续的， 顺序排列的 (adj.)
连续剧，连载故事 (n.)
words.s: Tom had no idea that Mary was a serial killer.
words.sz: 汤姆不知道玛丽是个连环杀手。

t: 预料， 预期， 期望； 先于…行动， 提前使用 (vt.)
words.s: I anticipate that there will be trouble.
words.sz: 我預料會有麻煩。
words.d: To anticipate something is to think that it will happen.

t: 拆卸； 使分开， 使分离 (vt.)
砍；大幅度削减 (vt.)
砍， 砍痕； 斜线号 (n.)
捏造， 伪造， 编造； 建造 (vt.)
喜剧的，滑稽的 (adj.)
连环漫画； 喜剧演员 (n.)
words.s: I found the comic book very interesting.
words.sz: 我發現這本漫畫書非常有趣。
words.d: When something is comic, it is funny.

t: 完美， 完善 (n.)
不明确的； 含糊的； 暧昧的 (adj.)
words.s: She had a vague feeling of guilt.
words.sz: 她隱約地有一種的內疚感。
words.d: If something is vague, it is not clear and gives very few details.

t: 教皇， 罗马主教 (n.)
例外， 除外 (n.)
words.s: It's been hot this month, but today's an exception.
words.sz: 这个月一直都很热，但今天是个例外。
words.d: An exception is someone or something not conforming to a rule.

t: 自我， 自己， 自尊 (n.)
words.s: Kelly’s ego made her think that she was some kind of a superhero.
words.d: An ego is a person’s sense of their own worth.

t: 鼓励；推进，催促；竭力主张，强烈要求 (vt.)
冲动， 强烈的欲望 (n.)
words.s: Advertisements urge us to buy luxuries.
words.sz: 廣告慫恿我們買奢侈品。
words.d: To urge someone is to try very hard to get them to do something.

t: 配偶 (n.)
words.s: I live in a home with my spouse and our two children.
words.d: A spouse is the person to whom someone is married.

t: 得分，比数，成绩；二十 (n.)
分， 给…打分； 画线于； 获胜 (vt.)
words.s: He got a better score than us.
words.sz: 他得到了比我们还高的分数。

t: 小岛， 岛 (n.)
四周有篱笆的场地， 围场； 附件 (n.)
研究生的 (adj.)
毕业 (v.)
毕业生；研究生 (n.)
words.s: Tom will graduate from high school the year after next.
words.sz: 湯姆將在後年高中畢業。
words.d: To graduate from a school means to complete and pass all courses of study there.

t: 饥荒； 严重的缺乏 (n.)
words.s: The farmers couldn’t grow any food in the dry soil, so there was a famine.
words.d: A famine is a long time with little or no food.

t: 定额， 限额， 配额 (n.)
全体一致的， 一致同意的 (adj.)
words.s: The election was unanimous.
words.sz: 选举一致通过了。

t: 轻蔑，鄙视 (n.)
轻蔑， 鄙视； 拒绝， 不屑 (vt.)
words.s: The criminal was scorned by everyone in the community.
words.d: To scorn someone means to behave without respect toward them.

t: 热的， 由热造成的； 保暖的 (adj.)
硫 (n.)
words.s: Sulfur burns with a blue flame.
words.sz: 硫磺燃燒著藍色的火焰。

t: 看的， 视觉的 (adj.)
words.s: The visual displays were very attractive.
words.d: Visual relates to seeing.

t: 地形， 地势 (n.)
words.s: The rugged terrain made the troops' advance difficult.
words.sz: 地面高低不平，給部隊前進帶來了困難。
words.d: The terrain is the land and all of its physical features or parts.

t: 悲伤， 悲痛； 悲伤的事， 悲痛的缘由 (n.)
words.s: The grief caused by losing her parents was very difficult for her.
words.d: Grief is the feeling of deep sadness, usually when a person dies.

t: 说唱 (vi.)
敲击，急敲；突然厉声说出；责备，训斥 (vt.)
敲击， 急敲 (n.)
words.s: Do you like rap?
words.sz: 你喜欢说唱音乐吗？

t: 提升，使升级 (vt.)
向上的斜坡 (n.)
words.s: He upgraded to a real fancy car.
words.d: To upgrade something means to improve it or make it more efficient.

t: 教， 指示； 通知； 教育 (vt.)
words.s: My teacher instructs us in several subjects.
words.d: To instruct is to teach.

t: 阑尾； 附录 (n.)
事实上， 实质上 (adv.)
令人愉快的， 惬意的； 同意的， 乐意的 (adj.)
words.s: She has an agreeable voice.
words.sz: 她的声音令人愉快。

t: 经济； 节约， 节省 (n.)
words.s: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
words.sz: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。
words.d: An economy is the money and businesses of a country or region.

t: 社区， 社会， 公社； 团体， 界； 群落 (n.)
words.s: Do you take part in any community activities?
words.sz: 你参加社团活动吗？
words.d: A community is a group of people who share the same area or interests.

t: 译文， 说法， 改写本 (n.)
words.s: This dictionary isn't the most recent version.
words.sz: 這本字典不是最新版的。
words.d: A version is an account of something that differs slightly from the original.

t: 撒，洒 (v.)
少量， 少数 (n.)
words.s: I'll sauté a few sweet potatoes and sprinkle them with sugar.
words.sz: 我去炸一點紅薯，然後在上面撒上糖。
words.d: To sprinkle means to scatter something all over something else.

t: 青铜， 青铜色， 古铜色； 青铜制品， 铜牌 (n.)
思想， 观念， 概念； 构想， 设想； 怀孕 (n.)
市的， 市政的 (adj.)
words.s: The municipal parking lot downtown can fit one hundred cars.
words.d: Municipal means that something belongs to a city or local government.

t: 拘留， 扣留； 留住， 耽搁 (vt.)
words.s: The police had to detain the thief for shoplifting.
words.d: To detain is to officially prevent someone from leaving a place.

t: 研究所，学院 (n.)
建立， 设立 (vt.)
words.s: I am going to a lecture about Ancient Rome at the Historical Institute.
words.d: An institute is an organization that is interested in research or teaching.

t: 忍受， 容忍； 持久， 持续 (v.)
words.s: Can she endure a long trip?
words.sz: 她能忍受長途旅行嗎？
words.d: To endure means to experience and survive something difficult.

t: 细节，枝节；零件 (n.)

words.s: I am writing a draft of the speech.
words.sz: 我在寫演講的草稿。
words.d: A draft is a piece of written work that is not in its final form.

综合体， 集合体； 情结， 夸大的情绪反应 (n.)
words.s: Do you know anything about complex carbohydrates?
words.sz: 你对复合碳水化合物有什么了解吗？
words.d: If something is complex, it has many small parts. It is hard to understand.

t: 假定， 臆断； 担任， 承担 (n.)

等级制度； 统治集团， 领导层 (n.)

t: 缺点， 欠缺； 不利条件 (n.)
words.s: The drawback of having a car is that it is very expensive to maintain.
words.d: A drawback is a disadvantage.

t: 长寿， 寿命 (n.)
words.s: Sea turtles have an amazing longevity.
words.d: Longevity is the ability to live for a long time.

t: 军事的；军用的 (adj.)
军队， 武装力量 (n.)
words.s: The Japanese military forces seemed too strong to stop.
words.sz: 日本军队看来强大得不可阻挡。
words.d: The military is the armed forces of a country.

t: 动力的， 动力学的； 动态的； 有活力的， 有生气的 (adj.)
words.s: The new, dynamic employee came up with a good way to juggle his workload.
words.d: When people are dynamic, they are lively and have creative ideas.

t: 衣柜； 全部衣物 (n.)
words.s: She bought some new clothes to expand her wardrobe.
words.d: A wardrobe is the collection of all of a person’s clothing.

t: 不情愿的， 勉强的 (adj.)
words.s: She was reluctant to say that she saw the robbery.
words.d: Reluctant means not wanting to do something.

t: 认真的， 勤勤恳恳的 (adj.)
激情， 热情； 酷爱 (n.)
words.s: The poet expressed his burning passion for the woman he loved.
words.sz: 詩人對他愛的女人表達了他火熱的激情。

t: 发生， 引起； 生殖 (vt.)
words.s: An electric current can generate magnetism.
words.sz: 電流可以產生磁性。
words.d: To generate something means to cause it to develop or begin.

t: 极度的；最后的 (adj.)
极端， 过分 (n.)
words.s: Your proposal is a bit extreme.
words.sz: 你的建議有點極端。

t: 把边塞到下面；把…夹入，把…藏入 (vt.)
褶， 裥 (n.)
有权威性的， 可信的； 专断的， 命令式的 (adj.)
words.s: This book is an authoritative source on ancient Egypt’s Queen Nefertiti.
words.d: If something is authoritative, it uses the best information available.

t: 运动员， 体育家 (n.)
words.s: Tom is a natural athlete.
words.sz: 汤姆天生就是个运动员。
words.d: An athlete is a person who plays sports.

t: 挺直着， 竖立着 (adv.)
垂直的；正直的，诚实的 (adj.)
words.s: Meerkats can’t walk like humans, but they can stand upright.
words.d: If something is upright, it is standing up straight.

t: 取出，抽出；采掘，提炼，榨取；获得，索取；摘录['3kstrækt] (vt.)
摘录， 选段； 提出物， 精， 汁 (n.)
words.s: The dentist extracted the woman’s damaged tooth and put in a fake one.
words.d: To extract something means to remove it.

t: 不著名的，不重要的；费解的，模糊不清的 (adj.)
使变糊， 掩盖 (vt.)
words.s: The meaning of this sentence is obscure.
words.sz: 这句句子意思模糊。
words.d: If something is obscure, it is not well known.

t: 失望，气馁；惊恐 (n.)
使失望， 使气馁； 使惊恐 (vt.)
花费， 消费； 消耗 (vt.)
打制， 锻造； 伪造 (vt.)
words.s: Stacy and Heather forged their friendship when they were teenagers.
words.d: To forge is to make or produce, especially with difficulty.

t: 说明， 论证； 表露 (vt.)
words.s: Can you demonstrate it?
words.sz: 您可以示範一下嗎?
words.d: To demonstrate something is to show how it is done.

t: 地区， 地带， 区域； 范围， 幅度 (n.)
words.s: A string of disasters struck the region.
words.sz: 一連串的災難襲擊這個地區。
words.d: A region is a large area of land usually based on some common feature.

t: 行骗 (vi.)
欺骗，蒙蔽 (vt.)
words.s: It's wrong to deceive people, but worse to deceive yourself.
words.sz: 欺騙別人是錯的,但更糟的欺騙自己。
words.d: To deceive is to make someone believe something that is not true.

t: 预映， 预演； 预告 (n.)
words.s: The band played us a preview of their new song.
words.d: A preview is an opportunity to see something before it is available to the public.

t: 设计独特的， 别致的， 巧妙的； 灵巧的， 善于创造发明的 (adj.)
words.s: Charles was the only person ingenious enough to repair the plane’s engines.
words.d: If someone is ingenious, then they are very smart.

t: 问卷， 征求意见表 (n.)
突破， 突破性进展， 重要的新发现 (n.)
快餐， 小吃， 点心 (n.)
words.s: What does Tom eat for a mid-afternoon snack?
words.sz: 湯姆下午茶點心都吃什麼？

t: 牛轭；束缚，枷锁 (n.)
结合， 联结 (vt.)
目的地， 终点； 目标 (n.)
words.s: They made straight for their destination.
words.sz: 他們直奔目的地。
words.d: A destination is the place where someone or something is going.

t: 御座， 宝座； 王位， 王权 (n.)
words.s: Prince William is second in line to the English throne.
words.sz: 威廉王子是英国王位第二顺位继承人
words.d: A throne is the special chair in which a ruler sits.

t: 个人自由； 隐私， 私生活， 私事 (n.)
words.s: Reporters do not hesitate to intrude into people's privacy.
words.sz: 记者没有犹豫地去干涉了人们的私生活。
words.d: Privacy is the state of being happily away from other people.

t: 相互的； 互惠的 (adj.)
垂直的， 竖式的 (adj.)
详细目录， 存货清单 (n.)
words.s: Gwen was checking the inventory to make sure we had what we needed.
words.d: An inventory is a supply of something.

t: 鲜艳的； 生动的， 栩栩如生的 (adj.)
words.s: The figures in the painting were vivid.
words.d: When something is vivid, it is bright and colorful.

t: 发红 (vi.)
齐平的， 同高的 (adj.)
words.s: The toilet doesn't flush properly.
words.sz: 厕所冲水不正常。
words.d: To flush means the face becomes red due to heat, illness, or emotion.

t: 继承人 (n.)
words.s: The princess was the heir to the king and queen’s throne.
words.d: An heir is a person who receives the money or property of someone who dies.

t: 螺丝 (n.)
用螺钉固定， 拧， 拧紧 (vt.)
成套工具，成套用品；配套元件 (n.)
装备 (vt.)
words.s: Don't forget to take the first-aid kit.
words.sz: 别忘了带上急救箱。
words.d: A kit is a set of all the things needed to do something.

t: 善， 美德； 优点， 长处 (n.)
words.s: My best virtue is forgiveness.
words.d: A virtue is a good quality or way of behaving.

t: 强调， 着重 (vt.)
words.s: I want to emphasize this point in particular.
words.sz: 我想特别强调这一点。

t: 营业额， 成交量； 人员调整， 人员更替率 (n.)
终有一死的；致命的；你死我活的，不共戴天的 (adj.)
凡人， 人类 (n.)
words.s: We know that all men are mortal.
words.sz: 我們知道人皆難免一死。
words.d: When a person is mortal, they cannot live forever.

t: 新闻报道； 覆盖范围 (n.)
出现；合乎情理 (vi.)
数字；人物；算术；体型，风姿；轮廓；画像，塑像；图，图形 (n.)
计算； 认为， 猜想 (vt.)
words.s: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.
words.sz: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。

t: 野兽般的， 残忍的； 无情的， 冷酷的， 难以忍受的 (adj.)
轻微的，微小的 (adj.)
侮慢；轻视，冷落 (v.)
words.s: Would you mind if I shut the window? I have a slight cold.
words.sz: 你不介意我关窗吧？我有点着凉了。
words.d: If something is slight, then it is small or minor.

t: 矿， 矿石 (n.)
words.s: The factory melted the ore and used it to make iron products.
words.d: Ore is the raw form of rock or material from which a valuable metal is taken.

t: 堕落的，腐败的，贪赃舞弊的 (adj.)
腐蚀， 使堕落 (vt.)
words.s: The file is corrupt.
words.sz: 文件已损坏。
words.d: If someone is corrupt, they break the law for money or fame.

t: 排除； 阻止， 妨碍 (vt.)
先的， 前的， 以前的 (adj.)
words.s: I would like to retract my previous statement.
words.sz: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。
words.d: If something is previous, then it happened earlier in time or order.

t: 政治制度， 政权 (n.)
words.s: He was a member of the old regime that had been overthrown in the election.
words.d: A regime is a system of government or management.

t: 传送， 传递； 传染； 播送， 发射 (vt.)
words.s: The radio tower transmits a signal to all the radios in a 20-kilometer radius.
words.d: To transmit something means to pass it from one person or place to another.

t: 纪念， 庆祝 (vt.)
争论，争辩，辩论 (vi.)

words.sz: 汤姆和玛丽无时无刻不在辩论。

words.s: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.
words.sz: 酒的消费每年都在上升。
words.d: The consumption of food or drink is the act of eating or drinking it.

t: 比预期时间早的； 不成熟的， 仓促的 (adj.)

words.d: If something is premature, then it is done too early or before the proper time.

t: 上级的，较高的；优越的；有优越感的，高傲的 (adj.)
上级， 长官 (n.)
words.s: This carpet is superior to that one in quality.
words.sz: 這地毯在質量上比那箇好得多。
words.d: A superior person or thing is better than another.

t: 干旱， 旱灾 (n.)
words.s: After three months of drought, the vegetation and trees started dying.
words.d: A drought is a long period of time in which little or no rain falls.

t: 周期的； 定期的； 时而发生的 (adj.)
期刊 (n.)
散发传单 (v.)
传单，散页印刷品，小册子 (n.)
附件， 零件， 配件； 装饰品； 同谋， 帮凶， 包庇犯 (n.)
words.s: The store sold colorful accessories like bags, sunglasses, and makeup.
words.d: An accessory is a thing that is added to another thing to make it look better.

t: 妥协； 危及； 放弃 (v.)
妥协，和解；折中办法 (n.)
words.s: We tried to come to a compromise with them.
words.sz: 我們試著和他們妥協。

words.sz: 研討會怎麼樣？

words.sz: 你看過富士山嗎?它美得無法形容。

words.sz: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。

证据，证明；校样，样张 (n.)

激进分子， 斗士 (n.)

t: 错综复杂； (n.)
阶段； 方面； 相， 相位 (n.)

t: 演出， 场面； 景象， 壮观； 眼镜 (n.)

t: 在头顶上 (adv.)
在头顶上的；架空的 (adj.)
经常费用， 管理费用 (n.)

words.sz: 合同已经到手了，那就出去庆祝一下吧。

推断出，推论出；缔结，议定 (vt.)
words.s: I saw crumbs on my dog’s face, so I concluded that he ate my cookie.
words.d: To conclude is to arrive at a logical end by looking at evidence.

t: 有利可图的， 有益的 (adj.)
words.s: We'll be profitable this year.
words.sz: 今年我们会盈利的。

t: 不幸， 厄运， 逆境； 不幸事故， 灾难， 灾祸 (n.)

words.sz: 她易患感冒。
words.d: If one is susceptible to something like a disease, they are easily harmed by it.

words.sz: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
words.d: Leather is a material made from animal skin that is used to make clothing.

t: 洞察力； 洞悉， 深刻的见解 (n.)
words.s: The physics textbook gave the student a new insight about gravity.
words.d: Insight is a deep and accurate understanding of something.

t: 完整无缺的； 未经触动的； 未受损伤的 (adj.)
words.s: Despite being over 30 years old, my father’s model ship is still intact.
words.d: When something is intact, it is complete and not damaged.

t: 起作用的， 有帮助的； 用乐器演奏的 (adj.)
words.s: I like instrumental music.
words.sz: 我喜歡器樂。

t: 织物， 纺织品； 结构 (n.)

words.sz: 這件衣服是由薄織物製成的。

革命者 (n.)
失业， 失业人数 (n.)

words.sz: 在2015年9月日本的失业率为3.4％。

未成年人， 少年 (n.)
强迫；用力推动，用力打开 (vt.)
军队， 兵力； 暴力， 武力； 力， 力气； 影响力， 效力 (n.)

words.sz: 我永遠不會逼你跟他結婚。

t: 同情的； 和谐的； 赞同的， 支持的； 合意的 (adj.)
周期的， 定期的， 时而发生的 (adj.)
分发， 分配， 分布 (n.)
起源， 衍生 (vi.)
取得，得到；追溯…的起源或来由 (vt.)

t: 容量； 能力； 能量； 才能； 身份， 地位 (n.)

words.sz: 这个房间能容纳200人。

t: 应付， 处理 (vi.)

words.sz: 湯姆失業後，為了排遣鬱悶的心情而開始了賭博。

t: 无意中听到， 偷听到 (vt.)
猛冲，飞奔 (vi.)

飞镖， 飞镖游戏； 急驰， 飞奔 (n.)
缺点， 瑕疵， 缺陷 (n.)

words.d: A flaw is a mistake in something that causes it to be less effective or correct.

t: 使湿透， 浸透； 使充满， 使饱和 (vt.)

words.d: To saturate something means to completely soak it with a liquid.

t: 特征，特色；面貌；特写，专题节目；故事片 (n.)
突出； 由…主演 (vt.)
words.s: It isn't a bug. It's an undocumented feature.
words.sz: 这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。
words.d: A feature is an important part of something.

t: 平直地； 直截了当地 (adv.)
平的；固定的；漏气的；单调的，沉闷的；浅的 (adj.)
一套房间，单元住宅 (n.)
words.s: My bicycle has a flat tire.
words.sz: 我的腳踏車輪胎沒氣了。
words.d: Flat describes something that is level and smooth with no curved parts.

t: 肯定地说， 断言； 维护， 坚持； 坚持己见 (vt.)
高潮， 最令人兴奋的部分 (n.)
回忆； 召回， 叫回； 收回， 撤销 (vt.)
words.s: I can't recall the last time we met.
words.sz: 我想不起來我們上次見面的情况了。
words.d: To recall something is to remember it.

t: 长方形的， 矩形的 (adj.)
飘动， 拍动； 振翅 (vi.)
片状垂悬物；飘动，摆动，振动；激动，慌忙状态 (n.)
使拍动，使飘动 (vt.)
words.s: The tiny bird flapped its wings and ate from the flowers.
words.d: To flap means to move quickly up and down or from side to side.

t: 精确的， 准确的； 严谨的 (adj.)
words.s: The precise time of their arrival is not known.
words.sz: 他們到達的確切時間還不明。
words.d: If someone is precise, then they are exact and careful about their work.

t: 明智的， 合情理的 (adj.)
words.s: It was sensible of you to follow her advice.
words.sz: 你聽從她的忠告是明智的。
words.d: A sensible person or thing is good and smart.

words.s: I have no objection to paying a special fee if it is necessary.
words.sz: 如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。

t: 珍贵的， 宝贵的 (adj.)

words.sz: 时间是世界上最宝贵的东西。

t: 谋划， 策划； 设法做到； 设计， 想出 (vt.)
