words.d: An inhabitant is a person who lives in a certain place.

t: 小部分， 片断； 【数】 分数 (n.)
words.s: Only a fraction of the cake was gone.
words.d: A fraction is a small part of something.

t: 象征性的， 装样子的 (adj.)
筹码；信物，标志，纪念品；代金券，礼券 (n.)
情感， 感情； 激动 (n.)
words.s: Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.
words.sz: 任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。
words.d: An emotion is how you feel.

t: 大的， 大而重的； 大块的； 大量的， 大规模的 (adj.)
words.s: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.
words.sz: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。
words.d: A massive thing is very big.

t: 对估价； 评价， 评论 (vt.)
words.s: She can assess investments very accurately.
words.sz: 她能很准确地评估投资。
words.d: To assess something means to judge the structure, purpose, or quality of it.

t: 混合起来， 相混合； 相交往， 相往来 (vi.)
使混合，使相混 (vt.)
处方， 药方， 药； 开处方， 开药方 (n.)
words.s: You cannot purchase this medicine without a prescription.
words.sz: 那个药的话没有处方是买不到的。
words.d: A prescription is permission from a doctor to get medicine.

t: 观众， 旁观者 (n.)
words.s: There were thousands of spectators at the big game.
words.d: A spectator is someone who watches something, for example, a sports event.

t: 可以吃的， 可食用的 (adj.)
words.s: This fish is not edible.
words.sz: 这条鱼不能吃了。

t: 易于…的， 很有可能…的； 俯卧的 (adj.)
合唱队；合唱，合唱曲；副歌，叠句；齐声，齐声说的话 (n.)
齐声说， 随声附和 (vt.)
欠； 应把…归功于； 感激， 感恩 (vt.)
words.s: I owe it you that I am still alive.
words.sz: 多亏了你，我还活着。

t: 资产， 财产； 有价值的特性或技能， 优点 (n.)
words.s: The coach realized the boy’s speed was an asset to the team.
words.d: An asset is a skill or quality that is useful or valuable.

t: 阐述， 讲解； 展览会， 博览会 (n.)
最低的， 最小的 (adj.)
最低限度，最小量 (n.)
words.s: What's the minimum wage in your country?
words.sz: 你的国家的最低工资是多少？
words.d: The minimum is the smallest amount.

t: 道歉， 认错， 谢罪 (n.)
words.s: Tom didn't accept Mary's apology.
words.sz: 汤姆不接受玛丽的道歉。
words.d: An apology is what people say to show that they are sorry.

t: 揭露， 泄露； 展现， 显示 (vt.)
words.s: I will reveal where I hid the candy bar.
words.d: To reveal is to show something.

t: 足够的； 可以胜任的 (adj.)
words.s: This meal is adequate for three.
words.sz: 这饭足够三个人吃。
words.d: Something adequate is good enough.

t: 猫头鹰 (n.)
words.s: I'm a night owl.
words.sz: 我是個夜貓子。

t: 软木，软木塞 (n.)
用瓶塞塞住 (vt.)
极大的， 非常的； 精彩的， 了不起的 (adj.)
words.s: The pressure was tremendous.
words.sz: 壓力很巨大。
words.d: A tremendous thing is very large or very good.

t: 标准， 规范； 准则 (n.)
words.s: Wearing a heavy coat all summer is not considered a norm.
words.d: A norm is a way of behaving that is considered normal in a particular society.

t: 使冷凝， 使凝结； 浓缩， 压缩， 简缩 (vt.)
words.s: The cool air made tiny drops of water condense on the tops of the grass.
words.d: To condense a gas means to make it a liquid.

t: 推动， 促进， 刺激； 推动力 (n.)
愤怒， 愤慨， 义愤 (n.)
栅栏； 检票口； 屏障； 障碍， 隔阂 (n.)
words.s: The Great Wall was a barrier between China and its enemies.
words.d: A barrier is something that blocks a path or way.

t: 现实的； 实际可行的； 现实主义的， 逼真的 (adj.)
words.s: Let's be realistic.
words.sz: 現實點吧。
words.d: When something is realistic, it is shown as it is in real life.

t: 使转向， 使改道； 转移， 转移…的注意力； 使娱乐， 使消遣 (vt.)
显眼的， 明显的 (adj.)
words.s: The scar on his forehead is conspicuous.
words.sz: 他額頭上的疤痕很醒目。

t: 诗， 诗句 (n.)
words.s: He translated the verse into English.
words.sz: 他把诗翻译成英语。

t: 犯罪的， 刑事的 (adj.)
犯人，罪犯，刑事犯 (n.)
words.s: His son's criminal activities caused him great pain.
words.sz: 他儿子的犯罪行为给他带来了很大的痛苦。

t: 狂怒的， 暴怒的； 强烈的， 激烈的 (adj.)
words.s: When Tom found out about that, he was furious.
words.sz: 当汤姆发现这件事时，他很生气。

t: 过度肥胖 (n.)
晒成棕褐色 (vi.)
使晒成棕褐色；硝制 (vt.)
棕褐色， 棕黄色； 晒成棕褐色， 晒黑 (n.)
words.s: He doesn't tan.
words.sz: 他晒不黑。

t: 个别的；独特的 (adj.)
个人， 个体 (n.)
words.s: Each individual is responsible for themselves.
words.d: An individual is a single member of a group.

t: 公文包， 公事包 (n.)
words.s: I left my briefcase on the bus.
words.sz: 我把我的公事包留在公車上了。

t: 讨厌的人； 麻烦事 (n.)
words.s: The teenager considered her noisy little brothers to be quite a nuisance.
words.d: A nuisance is a person or thing that is annoying or causes a lot of problems.

t: 做好准备；振作精神 (vi.)
使防备，使受锻炼；支住，撑牢，使绷紧 (vt.)
支架， 托架 (n.)
限制， 约束； 克制， 抑制 (vt.)
words.s: Jim cannot join us because he is constrained by previous plans.
words.d: To constrain something means to limit its development.

t: 轻快的， 生气勃勃的； 兴隆的， 繁忙活跃的； 寒冷而清新的 (adj.)
威信， 威望 (n.)
words.s: The young actress gained much prestige after she won an award.
words.d: If a person has prestige, people admire or respect them.

t: 绝缘 (n.)
细绳， 粗线， 索； 灯芯绒裤 (n.)
words.s: This extension cord is too short.
words.sz: 這條延長線太短了。

t: 使惊吓， 使吃惊 (vt.)
words.s: The loud crash startled the sleeping woman.
words.d: To startle means to scare someone suddenly.

t: 暂时的，临时的 (adj.)
间歇， 过渡期间 (n.)
欺诈， 诈骗； 骗子 (n.)
words.s: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.
words.sz: 学术造假比你想象的普遍。
words.d: Fraud is the crime of gaining money by lying or by tricking people.

t: 证词； 见证， 证明 (n.)
理事会， 委员会 (n.)
words.s: You should run for city council.
words.sz: 你应该去竞选城市委员会。
words.d: A council is a group of people who run a city or town.

t: 重申； 再确认 (vt.)
实施， 执行； 强制， 强迫， 迫使 (vt.)
words.s: Police enforce traffic laws to keep everyone safe.
words.d: To enforce means to make a person follow a rule.

t: 闪闪发光，闪耀 (vi.)
闪光， 灿烂的光辉； 耀眼， 辉煌 (n.)
命中注定的， 预定的； 以…为目的地的 (adj.)
压抑， 压制， 镇压 (n.)
易碎的， 脆的， 易损坏的； 虚弱的， 脆弱的 (adj.)
words.s: The fragile glassware was carefully packed into boxes.
words.d: When people or things are fragile, they are not strong and can be damaged easily.

t: 处罚， 惩罚； 罚金 (n.)
words.s: The death penalty had been done away with in many states in the USA.
words.sz: 死刑在美国的很多州都被废除了。

t: 社会学 (n.)
words.s: Sociology teaches that people’s problems are a result of their society.
words.d: Sociology is the study of human society, its organizations, and problems.

t: 流放，流亡；被流放者，流亡国外者 (n.)
流放， 放逐， 使流亡 (vt.)
大小，规模；等级，级别；天平，磅秤；比例；刻度，标度；鳞 (n.)
攀登， 爬越 (vt.)
words.s: I was surprised by the scale of the buildings in the downtown area.
words.d: The scale of something is its size, especially when it is very large.

t: 巨大的， 庞大的 (adj.)
与其他不同的； 清楚的， 明确的 (adj.)
words.d: A distinct thing is different or stands out.

t: 植物， 草木 (n.)
恢复， 痊愈； 追回， 寻回， 收复 (n.)
words.s: There is no hope of his recovery.
words.sz: 他沒有希望痊癒了。

t: 地质学； 地质情况 (n.)
words.s: Because he studied geology, he knew how the mountains were formed.
words.d: Geology is the study of the Earth’s natural structures and how they change.

t: 举起，升起，吊起 (vt.)
起重器械； 举起， 升起， 吊起 (n.)
知道的， 意识到的 (adj.)
words.s: It's hard to believe that Tom wasn't aware that Mary was in love with him.
words.sz: 真难相信汤姆不知道玛丽爱他。
words.d: If someone is aware, they know that something or a situation exists.

t: 夸脱 (n.)
words.s: I want a quart of milk.
words.sz: 我要一夸脫的牛奶。

t: 数字的； 用数字表示的； 数值的 (adj.)
一瘸一拐地走，蹒跚 (vi.)
软弱的，无生气的，无精神的；软的，松沓的 (adj.)
跛行 (n.)
words.s: After the injury, the player limped off of the field.
words.d: To limp means to walk with difficulty because someone’s leg or foot is hurt.

t: 安全， 保障； 抵押品； 证券 (n.)
words.s: Germany adopted a social security system in the 1880's.
words.sz: 德国在1880年代采取了一种社会保障制度。

t: 奖，奖品；判定 (n.)
授予， 给予； 判给， 裁定 (vt.)
words.s: He got an award for having the best grades in class.
words.d: An award is a prize for doing something well.

t: 猛然弓背跃起 (vi.)
美元，澳元；雄鹿，雄兔 (n.)
有条件被选中的； 合适的， 合意的 (adj.)
words.s: If he were a little younger, he would be eligible for the post.
words.sz: 如果他年轻一点，他将很适合这个职位。
words.d: If someone is eligible, then they are permitted to do or have something.

t: 惊恐，忧虑，警报 (n.)
使惊恐， 使担心 (vt.)
words.s: It's much better to be woken by the birds than by an alarm.
words.sz: 被闹钟唤醒没有被鸟唤醒的好。
words.d: An alarm is something that warns people of danger.

t: 虚弱的， 衰弱的， 无力的； 无效的， 无益的 (adj.)
words.s: The boy was too feeble to carry the object very far.
words.d: If someone is feeble, they are small or weak.

t: 估计， 估量； 评价 (n.)
连续的； 频频的 (adj.)
药草， 香草； 草本植物 (n.)
words.s: I couldn’t decide which herb I wanted to buy at the market.
words.d: An herb is a plant used for cooking or medicine.

t: 散文 (n.)
肢， 臂， 腿； 树枝 (n.)
words.s: The monkey sat on the tree limb and enjoyed a piece of fruit.
words.d: A limb is a large branch on a tree.

t: 方向， 目标， 方位； 熟悉情况， 适应， 情况介绍 (n.)
茶点， 点心； 恢复， 精神爽快 (n.)
信任， 信赖； 信心， 自信 (n.)
words.s: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.
words.sz: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。
words.d: Confidence is a feeling of certainty or ability.

t: 随心所欲的； 专断的 (adj.)
words.s: The classroom had many arbitrary rules that confused me.
words.d: If something is arbitrary, it is not based on any plan or system, so it seems random.

t: 专心的， 专注的； 急切的 (adj.)
意图，意向，目的 (n.)
words.s: The only difference between a bad cook and a poisoner is the intent.
words.sz: 一個差勁的廚師和下毒者唯一的不同在於他們的意圖。
words.d: An intent is a plan to do something.

t: 被动的， 消极的 (adj.)
words.s: Watching TV is a passive activity.
words.sz: 看電視是一種被動的活動。
words.d: A passive person does not take action to solve problems.

t: 肥料 (n.)
相应的， 符合的 (adj.)
誓言， 誓约； 咒骂， 诅咒语 (n.)
words.s: The knight swore an oath of allegiance to the king.
words.sz: 騎士宣誓效忠於國王。
words.d: An oath is a formal, often public, promise.

t: 回答， 答复； 反应， 响应 (n.)
words.s: I'm sorry for the late response.
words.sz: 我很抱歉回复晚了。
words.d: A response is the answer to a question.

t: 条约， 协议， 协定 (n.)
words.s: In 1978 a peace treaty was concluded between Japan and China.
words.sz: 1978年中国和日本签署了和平条约。

t: 庄严， 端庄； 尊严， 高贵 (n.)
words.s: Please conduct yourself with dignity.
words.sz: 请自重。
words.d: Dignity is the ability to be calm and worthy of respect.

t: 挑战，邀请比赛；艰巨的任务；怀疑，质问 (n.)
反对， 公然反抗； 向…挑战； 对…质疑 (vt.)
words.s: We accept your challenge.
words.sz: 我們接受你們的挑戰。
words.d: A challenge is something difficult to complete.

t: 竞争的，对抗的 (adj.)
竞争对手，敌手；可与匹敌的人 (n.)
与…竞争； 与…匹敌， 比得上 (vt.)
words.s: The three rivals were all competing for the same job.
words.d: A rival is someone trying to achieve the same thing as another.
